title: AI Product Owner
description: About Legal 500 Legal 500 is a global legal market research, data and intelligence business. Our research helps corporate clients make informed decisions about legal representation and gives law firms insight into their market position, performance, and clients. Beyond research, we’re building a growing data, benchmarking, market-intelligence and subscription service offering. We bring the legal market together through a global programme of events - awards ceremonies, conferences and roundtables that convene leading law firms, in-house teams and their advisers. And through Legal Business, our journalistic title, we deliver independent news, analysis and commentary on the business of law and the strategy, performance and leadership of the world’s leading law firms. We are a growing, multi-site organisation, with colleagues working across research, data, technology, product, journalism, commercial and events in London, Leeds and Bristol. About the Role: Our new AI Product Owner will provide central product ownership for AI capabilities developed and used across Legal 500, spanning multiple business units, functions and AI products. We see the primary premise of this role is to ensure that investment in AI is prioritised against Legal 500’s business objectives, that products solve clearly defined business problems, and that appropriate quality, governance, human oversight and accountability are built into their lifecycle. What you'll do: You will have the opportunity to operate as centrally within Legal 500, sitting within the 'Project' unit within our People & Business Operations function. You'll work across business-unit leaders, users, Technology, Data, Governance and relevant technology partners or suppliers. You'll be accountable for maintaining an enterprise AI product portfolio and roadmap and have responsibility for translating business needs into prioritised product requirements. This role is also about overseeing adoption and value realisation and ensuring AI products continue to improve as Legal 500’s operating models evolve. There is a possibility we may grow this team out to support on AI-specific engineering tasks. What we're looking for: Essential Strong product ownership background, ideally managing a portfolio of products or initiatives across multiple functions in an AI, data, digital or knowledge-intensive environment in a business change context Good understanding of how generative AI and related technologies can be applied to business processes (this role is not about having deep engineering expertise) Ability to quickly understand different business functions and complex processes, and translate them into clear product requirements, priorities and measurable outcomes Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to challenge AI outputs and understand issues such as hallucination, bias, confidence and evidence quality Experience working across multiple business units and technology teams, balancing competing priorities and communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders Curious and comfortable challenging established ways of working with a commercial and outcome-focused approach rather than technology-led Comfortable working in an evolving environment where AI capabilities and operating practices will continue to change. Desirable An understanding of professional services, publishing, legal markets, research or other knowledge-intensive environments would be advantageous. Role information: Hybrid workplace - 3 days a week in office, 2 days remote This role can be based in either London or Leeds Occasional travel to the other offices may be required (Bristol, London and Leeds) Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: City Scout - Switzerland
description: About Atlys Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely. Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers. Atlys is changing that. We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries . But we’re still early. The Role We're looking for a City Scout to help build the most reliable database of work-friendly cafes for travellers. You'll visit cafes across your assigned city, verify information like WiFi quality, internet speed, plug points and overall work-friendliness, and submit accurate data that powers a new Atlys product. Every visit directly improves the travel experience for thousands of users. The Job Explore and discover great cafes: Visit assigned cafes across your city, experience them as a customer, and identify places that travellers would genuinely enjoy working from. Collect high-quality on-ground data: Verify key details including WiFi availability, internet speed, passwords, plug points, seating, ambience and overall work-friendliness to ensure the information is accurate and reliable. Contribute to a travel product used by thousands: Capture your observations by completing a short digital survey after every visit, helping build one of the world's most reliable databases of work-friendly cafes. Cover your city efficiently: Plan your visits across assigned neighbourhood clusters to maximize coverage while maintaining consistency and quality. Maintain exceptional data quality: Pay close attention to detail, validate every submission, and ensure the information travellers see on the Atlys app can be trusted. The Ideal Candidate You’ll likely thrive in this role if you: Are a college student or have a flexible part-time schedule. Enjoy exploring your city and discovering new places. Have strong attention to detail and collect information accurately. Are comfortable travelling independently within your city. Own a smartphone and are reliable, proactive and self-driven. We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure. What you can expect Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work. Here’s what you can expect: Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create. Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us. A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off. Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office , so the basics are taken care of while we build together. Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft. Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible. Great tools to do your best work , including high-spec equipment and software. An office designed for more than just work , with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator. Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront. title: Senior Category Manager Indirect Procurement CapEx (All genders)
description: <h2><strong>The role</strong></h2> <p>We need a hands-on CapEx procurement expert, not a generalist. You'll lead strategic sourcing for capital investments across HelloFresh's European production sites: machinery, automated lines, Material Handling Equipment (MHE), and facility build-outs. You'll be embedded with Engineering and Operations from spec to handover, owning multi-million euro decisions. This role reports to the Director Indirect Procurement. </p> <p>We are looking for an ambitious, confident, entrepreneurial, and high-spirited Procurement professional with a strength for data processing, optimisation & reporting, ability to navigate ambiguity, attention to detail and great stakeholder management ability.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own end-to-end CapEx sourcing: supplier market mapping, RFx execution, negotiation, and contract award for high-value capital projects</li> <li>Develop a multi-year CapEx category strategy covering production machinery, conveyors & MHE, cold storage, and building fit-outs</li> <li>Lead Total Cost of Ownership modelling and investment scenario analysis with Engineering and Finance</li> <li>Drive Early Supplier Involvement (ESI) to influence specs and design-to-cost outcomes before projects are locked</li> <li>Build and manage the supplier portfolio across Hello Fresh’s markets: qualification, performance tracking, and continuous improvement</li> <li>Partner with Project Management and Site Operations from inception through commissioning — not just at the buying stage</li> <li>Monitor equipment markets, supplier landscape, and technology trends relevant to food production and logistics</li> <li>Support broader Procurement Ops team, if necessary, in MRO, Facilities Management, Utilities, etc. projects.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>6+ years in procurement, with at least 3–4 years of dedicated CapEx category ownership</li> <li>Proven track record sourcing capital equipment: production machinery, automated systems, conveyors/MHE, or equivalent industrial CapEx</li> <li>Engineering degree or equivalent technical background strongly preferred: you need to speak your stakeholders' language</li> <li>Experience managing large-scale sourcing across multiple European markets</li> <li>Fluent in English; German and/or French is a meaningful advantage</li> <li>Strong TCO and financial modelling skills; able to build business cases alongside Engineering and Finance</li> <li>Able travel to production sites across Europe if necessary.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer</strong></h2> <p>Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.</p> <ul> <li>Initially we offer 2 years contract. </li> <li>Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.</li> <li>Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.</li> <li>Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.</li> <li>Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.</li> <li>Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Are you up for the challenge?</strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please submit your complete application below including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.</span></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within 5 business days. </span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>HelloFresh is committed to the principles of equal employment opportunity and providing reasonable accommodations to candidates with disabilities. If you need an accommodation during the application process, please reach out to us at:</p> <p>Europe: ----- ----- States: ----- ----- Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Specialist Account Executive - ZT Branch
description: <div class="content-intro"><p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.</p> <p>We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.</p></div><p><strong>Role</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Specialist Account Executive to join our team. title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Data Intelligence Applications (m/f/d)

Analytical SQL & Warehouse Caching: Strong analytical SQL skills (window functions, CTEs, multi-level aggregations) and practical experience designing materialization/caching strategies over columnar cloud warehouses. Client-Side State & Data Management: Expertise with client-side caching, request coalescing, streaming, and table virtualization (e.g., TanStack Query, SWR). Determinism & Lineage: Own system lineage, versioning, and execution auditability end-to-end, ensuring any score can be recalculated identically at any future date. Internal Tools & API Layer: Build clean, typed services and contracts for our internal methodology workbench and downstream consumer applications. Testing & Quality Discipline: Establish rigorous testing practices (e.g., golden file testing, property-based testing, regression validation) to prevent calculation drift. Technical Ownership: Shape architecture, drive trade-offs between execution speed and cost, set code review standards, and mentor joining engineers. Qualifications Core Requirements (Must-Haves) Graph Algorithms & Engine Concepts: Deep expertise in modeling and evaluating expression trees and dependency graphs (e.g., ASTs, DAGs, cycle detection, topological sorting, memoization, and selective recomputation). Advanced Python & Typing Discipline: Mastery of modern Python with strict typing (mypy/pyright), explicit testing discipline, and clean packaging practices. Deterministic System Design: Proven experience building auditable, reproducible systems using immutable execution records, versioned schemas, and explicit data lineage tracking. Declarative Logic & Domain Modeling: Experience treating business logic as versioned data (e.g., typed schemas, expression trees, rules engines, or domain-specific configurations). Typed API & Schema Design: Demonstrated ability to design, version, and operate production backend contracts and schemas for upstream workflow engines and downstream applications. Cloud Infrastructure: Familiarity with deploying, monitoring, and operating containerized calculation microservices on AWS. Your Profile Degree: Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. Experience: 5+ years in backend software engineering building computation engines, rules platforms, or complex data-intensive backend systems; including a sustained period within one organization seeing a core system through build → launch → iteration. Domain Knowledge: Healthcare or benchmarking domain experience is a plus (basic understanding of healthcare KPIs, quality metrics, or benchmarking concepts; familiarity with hospital rating systems, medical classification, or complex scoring methodologies is especially valuable). Mindset: Strong analytical and mathematical mindset, with a proven ability to translate complex domain logic and formulas into clean, deterministic software abstractions. title: Senior Ground Software Engineer
description: Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability At Hypersonica , we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast. By joining Hypersonica , you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously. We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence. What you'll do Design and develop ground software used for mission preparation, execution, and monitoring of hypersonic systems. Build robust, user facing applications for Linux and Windows environments that support operators and engineers during real missions. Implement high performance C++ software with a focus on reliability, usability, and maintainability. Develop intuitive user interfaces and workflows to visualise system state, mission data, and operational status. Integrate ground software with simulation, test, and live system interfaces to support end to end operations. Work closely with systems, GNC, test, and operations teams to translate mission needs into effective software tools. Where useful, leverage UI frameworks (e.g. Qt) and mapping or visualisation SDKs to accelerate development. Who you are A Senior software engineer with 5+ years’ experience building ground or operator-facing software in aerospace, defence , or complex technical domains. Comfortable developing user-facing applications on Linux and Windows, with an understanding of operational reliability. Fluent in modern C++, with an instinct for performance, robustness, and clean architecture. Someone who cares deeply about operator experience, clarity, and usability in high-pressure environments. Experienced translating mission and system needs into practical software tools, not just features. Pragmatic about tooling, with exposure to UI frameworks such as Qt and an interest in visualisation or mapping technologies. Able to move quickly in a startup environment, balancing polish with delivery speed. Motivated by building software that operators trust during real missions, not demo-only systems. What we offer A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security. Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence , with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow. High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement , just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes. A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions. A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly. Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy. At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply. Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential. You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Engineering Manager, Platform
description: <p class="p1"><strong>Firmus Technologies</strong></p> <p class="p2">Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure from model to grid. Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.</p> <p class="p2">At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. This co-designed approach from model to grid allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.</p> <p class="p2"> </p> <p class="p1"><strong>Firmus AI Cloud</strong></p> <p class="p2">Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale. It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.</p> <p class="p2"> </p> <p class="p1"><strong>Why you’ll love working here</strong></p> <p class="p2">At Firmus, you’ll work at the intersection of sustainability and artificial intelligence in a fast-paced environment powered by next-generation technology. You’ll be helping to transform an entire industry — and you’ll feel it every day.</p> <p class="p2">Our team is made up of true innovators and leaders in their fields, and as an emerging company, you won’t be lost in a crowd. You’ll work closely with the founders, build a strong network, and see the impact of your work first-hand as we democratise AI tools for everyone — more sustainably and more affordably.</p> <p class="p2">We believe great things happen when people from diverse backgrounds come together to do their best work and be their authentic selves. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing">ROLE</span></span></strong></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW245217756 BCX4" lang="EN-AU" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW245217756 BCX4" data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing">Firmus Technologies is seeking an Engineering Manager to lead the Platform Engineering and Observability team. You are accountable for both the people and the delivery: the engineers you grow and the platform software they ship. Your team builds and </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW245217756 BCX4" data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing">operates</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW245217756 BCX4" data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing"> the platform beneath the Firmus AI Cloud, from bare-metal GPU compute and high-performance networking to the internal platform services, self-service tooling, and the observability platform that our engineering teams and customers depend on. You run these as products for the engineering teams that build on them, investing in self-service, reliability, and developer experience. You are the escalation point above first-line operations and own the cross-cutting decisions your team shares. This is a build-and-grow leadership role: you build the team that scales our AI platform toward gigawatt-scale AI factories across the regions and grow your scope as you earn it.</span></span><span class="EOP Selected SCXW245217756 BCX4" data-ccp-props="{"335551550":6,"335551620":6}"> </span><br> </p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing">KEY RESPONSIBILITIES</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":6,"335551620":6}"> </span></strong></p> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="5" data-list-defn-props="{"335551500":2448933,"335552541":1,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><strong><span data-contrast="none">Team Leadership & Growth</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335551550":6,"335551620":6,"335559739":120,"335559740":252}"> </span></li> </ul> <p><span data-contrast="none">Be the Single-Threaded Owner (STO) for multiple squads: their engineers and tech leads report to you, and you work alongside product, architecture, and delivery peers. Hire strong engineers, develop them through coaching and clear feedback, and manage performance directly. Own the org design, headcount planning, and engineering culture for your group, building a team that raises its own bar rather than depending on you.</span> <span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335551550":6,"335551620":6,"335559685":720,"335559739":120,"335559740":252}"> </span></p> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="5" data-list-defn-props="{"335551500":2448933,"335552541":1,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="2" data-aria-level="1"><strong><span data-contrast="none">Delivery & Execution</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335551550":6,"335551620":6,"335559739":120,"335559740":252}"> </span></li> </ul> <p><span data-contrast="none">Own end-to-end delivery for your team. Turn the product roadmap into sequenced, predictable delivery, shaping prioritisation with product and working with team leads on sprint planning and release gates. Own the cross-squads' dependencies that determine whether the platform ships on time, keep delivery health visible through metrics, and balance velocity against reliability and technical debt.</span> <span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335551550":6,"335551620":6,"335559685":720,"335559739":120,"335559740":252}"> </span></p> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="5" data-list-defn-props="{"335551500":2448933,"335552541":1,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="3" data-aria-level="1"><strong><span data-contrast="none">Technical Direction</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335551550":6,"335551620":6,"335559739":120,"335559740":252}"> </span></li> </ul> <p><span data-contrast="none">Stay technically credible and set the engineering quality bar across your squads. You are accountable for making sure the right cross-cutting decisions get made and driven to closure, such as build, buy, or open source, and the product SLAs your teams commit to. Keep design and code review rigorous, champion AI-assisted development so your teams ship faster without lowering the design, review, or security bar, and unblock the hard problems that stall delivery.</span> <span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335551550":6,"335551620":6,"335559685":720,"335559739":120,"335559740":252}"> </span></p> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="5" data-list-defn-props="{"335551500":2448933,"335552541":1,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="4" data-aria-level="1"><strong><span data-contrast="none">Operational Excellence & Governance</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335551550":6,"335551620":6,"335559739":120,"335559740":252}"> </span></li> </ul> <p><span data-contrast="none">Own the reliability and security of the services your squads run in production. Act as the escalation point above the operations centre, accountable for L3 incident resolution, SLA-breach response, and post-mortems that convert into runbook and prevention work. Set the standards for SLOs, on-call, and change management, backed by the observability platform your team owns. Govern how AI-generated code and agentic workloads reach production, extend Firmus' existing SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 controls as the platform scales into new data centres, and own the cost efficiency of what your team operate, balancing reliability, performance, and speed against infrastructure spend. </span> <span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335551550":6,"335551620":6,"335559685":720,"335559739":120,"335559740":252}"> </span></p> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="5" data-list-defn-props="{"335551500":2448933,"335552541":1,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="5" data-aria-level="1"><strong><span data-contrast="none">Stakeholder & Customer Communication</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335551550":6,"335551620":6,"335559739":120,"335559740":252}"> </span></li> </ul> <p><span data-contrast="none">Represent your team to engineering leadership and the CTO, clear about progress, risk, and the decisions you need. Own the engineering side of the customer relationship: lead customer technical briefings, and represent engineering directly when escalations turn on delivery, reliability, or architecture. Align with product, who own the roadmap and customer outcomes, with the architects on technical direction, and with delivery and operations so the platform ships and runs as one system, not a set of parts.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335551550":6,"335551620":6,"335559685":720,"335559739":120,"335559740":252}"> </span></p> <p> </p> <p><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing"><strong>SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE</strong> </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":6,"335551620":6}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing">Education</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":6,"335551620":6,"335559685":720,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":259,"335559991":360}"> </span></p> <ul> <li data-leveltext="o" data-font="Courier New" data-listid="5" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559685":1440,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Courier New","469769242":[9675],"469777803":"left","469777804":"o","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="2"><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing">Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field.</span></span></li> <li data-leveltext="o" data-font="Courier New" data-listid="5" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541"

title: B2B Sales Specialist
description: About Motorway Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better. About the role This is a consultative B2B sales role focused on driving platform adoption across UK car dealerships and encouraging active daily auction participation. You’ll manage a varied portfolio of dealer partners across the UK, ranging from onboarding brand-new businesses and winning back lapsed accounts, to optimizing performance for established, regular buyers. Rather than hard-selling from a rigid script, your goal is to ask great questions, understand each dealership’s unique business goals and position the value of Motorway to demonstrate a clear ROI. You will ultimately build high-value, collaborative and long-term relationships. Whether you’re delivering a powerful first impression to a new account or embedding repeatable, profitable processes into an existing or lapsed partner's daily routine, you'll act as a trusted advisor to help them win. We don't expect you to know everything on day one, but we do look for solid sales foundations, curiosity, and a drive to learn. We’ll back you with structured coaching, dedicated mentorship, and all the tools you need to succeed. What You’ll Do Consult & Position: Conduct high-level business conversations to uncover dealership needs, positioning Motorway as an essential, long-term inventory solution. Drive Network Activity: Onboard new dealership partners, re-engage cold or lapsed accounts, and nurture regular users to drive daily auction participation. Demonstrate Value Fast: Clearly articulate ROI to new or hesitant dealers while building repeatable, sustainable buying habits for mature accounts. Pipeline Ownership: Maintain exceptional CRM hygiene using HubSpot to log activity, manage your pipeline, and report accurately. Overcome Friction: Confidently navigate objections, address dealer pain points, and follow up consistently to keep conversations moving forward. Collaborate for Impact: Work closely with cross-functional teams to resolve dealer challenges and feed market insights back to our product team. Hit Targets: Take ownership of your numbers, proactively seeking coaching and feedback whenever you spot room to grow. Who You Are Sales Foundations: You have background experience in B2B or outbound sales, working comfortably against key performance targets. Consultative Mindset: You ask smart questions before pitching, listening intently to tailor your value proposition to each business. Adaptable Communicator : Exceptional telephone manner with the confidence to speak to business owners and decision-makers at all levels. CRM Competent: Comfortable managing a pipeline and staying organised across a busy, diverse portfolio using HubSpot (or a similar CRM). Resilient & Driven: Rejection doesn't derail you; it motivates you to follow up. You’re genuinely energised by hitting and exceeding targets. Relationship Builder: You're motivated by true customer success and prefer doing things right over closing a bad deal fast. Continuous Learner: You’re coachable and take ownership of your development. Life in the Team The B2B Sales team at Motorway is a tight-knit, collaborative group who work hard, celebrate wins together, and genuinely look out for one another. You’ll be encouraged to test new approaches, ask questions, and share ideas. You'll be based in our multi-story, sea-fronted Brighton office located in the heart of the city next to Churchill Square, where vibrant culture and professional growth go hand in hand. We offer a fantastic range of benefits to help you thrive £26,000 starting salary (OTE £48,000) Great work-life balance with standard shifts from 9am to 5:30pm Sea fronted office location with regular social events, office drinks, weekly massages and free snacks to keep you going! Flexibility to work from home 1 day per week to help nail that work life balance Stock options so you can share in Motorway’s growth and future success Pension scheme to plan for your future with our provider NEST Strong commitment to your personal development including budget for books, courses, conferences, etc! Opt-in comprehensive health insurance through BUPA including fitness discounts Cycle to work scheme - save big ££ on a new bike and accessories One paid volunteering day a year for you to use as you wish Generous parental benefits including 6 months full paid maternity leave, 4 weeks paternity leave and and workplace nursery scheme ... and much more! title: Satellite Data Processing Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.</strong></p> <p>Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.</p> <p>Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.</p> <p>As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.</p> <p>We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.</p> <p>Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role: </strong></p> <p>Image Quality Support (IQS) makes sure Planet's imagery meets that bar. We sit between imaging operations, satellite operations, software engineering, and the business — close enough to engineering to build our own tools, close enough to customers to know what "quality" means to them.</p> <p>We're looking for a Satellite Data Processing Engineer to help assess and automate imagery quality across Planet's satellite fleet. You'll split your time between hands-on visual QA and writing the software that scales it — a hybrid of remote-sensing know-how and software engineering, building up both with guidance from senior teammates.</p> <p>This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week.</p> <p><strong>Impact You’ll Own:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Assess satellite imagery, manually and via automated tooling, against contractual and technical quality standards.</li> <li>Help build and maintain the internal tools that power quality assessment — from QGIS-based QA tooling to backend scripts and data pipelines.</li> <li>Support investigations into customer-reported quality disputes, gathering technical evidence for the team's decisions.</li> <li>Contribute to the team's automated quality-assessment systems, helping shift routine checks from manual review into automation.</li> <li>Write clear reports and tickets that other engineering teams can act on.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>2+ years of relevant experience.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in geoinformatics, geomatics, remote sensing, or a closely related field.</li> <li>A working understanding of optical remote sensing fundamentals.</li> <li>Solid Python skills: comfortable with version control, code review, and writing more than one-off scripts.</li> <li>Exposure to QGIS or Python geospatial libraries (e.g. GDAL, rasterio, shapely).</li> <li>Basic SQL / database familiarity.</li> <li>Clear written communication: you can explain a technical finding to a non-specialist.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You Stand Out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Linux comfort.</li> <li>Experience with CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitLab CI).</li> <li>Any exposure to desktop GUI development (e.g. PySide6/Qt) or building small internal tools end-to-end.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Application Deadline:</strong></p> <p>11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.</p> <p><strong>Export Control Requirements:</strong></p> <p><em>Planet Labs Germany GmbH is authorized to receive U.S. export-controlled information at Planet under an export license issued by the Bureau of Industry and Security. This position requires access to U.S. and German/EU export-controlled information, and as such, employment (or hiring of a contractor) is contingent upon the candidate’s ability to access all applicable export-controlled information without additional export licensing being required by German, EU, or U.S. authorities.</em></p> <p><strong>Benefits While Working at Planet:</strong></p> <p><em>These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy.</em></p> <ul> <li>Paid time off including vacation, holidays and company-wide days off </li> <li>Employee Wellness Program </li> <li>Home Office Reimbursement</li> <li>Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement</li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning</li> <li>Equity </li> <li>Volunteering Paid Time Off</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation:</strong></p> <p>The expected starting gross salary range for this role is listed below. Individual placement within this range is determined objectively based on gender-neutral criteria such as your skills, qualifications, and professional experience. This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses and/or equity.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Germany Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€38.000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€47.500 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance<br></strong>Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.<strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>Why we care so much about Belonging. <br></strong>We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work.  If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply!  At Planet, we are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute to more ways than just what is listed in this job description.  We don’t just fill positions, we aspire to fulfill people’s careers, most excited about folks who are motivated by our underlying humanitarian efforts.  We are a few orbits around the sun before we get to where we want to be, so we hope you’re excited to come along for the ride. </p> <p><strong>EEO statement: <br></strong>Planet is committed to building a community where everyone belongs and we invite people from all backgrounds to apply. title: Senior Creative Producer (Fixed-term Employment)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><p>Wolt is a Finnish technology company known for its local commerce platform. From food delivery to grocery stores and cosmetics, we make cities better places to live by connecting people with the things they need. Our Global Creative Production team is currently undergoing a massive transformation, shifting from a reactive service center to an "upstream AI-Enabled growth engine".</p> <p>We are looking for a <strong>Senior Creative Producer </strong>to join us at this pivotal moment. </p> <p><strong>This is a 6-month fixed contract opportunity starting ASAP. </strong></p> <p><strong>Location: Helsinki, Berlin, Athens, Stockholm, Copenhagen </strong></p> <h2>What you’ll be doing</h2> <p>As the Senior Creative Producer, you will manage digital projects from brief to final delivery. You’ll thrive in cross-functional collaboration across different business departments such as B2B, Communication, New Verticals, and Wolt+ teams. You’ll own project timelines for successful deliveries,  weekly standups, daily communication with stakeholders and creative teams, and the localization and QA process during the production of social and digital assets. </p> <p>You will own the end-to-end production of digital advertising projects, ensuring our creative assets are not only on-brand but also built for massive scale across global markets. You will be responsible for the day-to-day organization of the team and daily communication from brief to delivery. </p> <h2><strong>Day-to-day in this role, you’ll:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>End-to-End Delivery:</strong> Manage digital projects and multi-channel campaigns from concept to launch. Our deliverables touch social, in-app, DOOH, event collateral, and OOH. </li> <li><strong>Resource & Budget Control:</strong> Oversee project costs, timelines, and team allocations without losing creative quality. </li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Management:</strong> Align internal marketing teams, designers, and external agencies on project milestones and timelines. Daily and/or weekly status updates are crucial for the success of our projects. </li> <li><strong>Time Management & Multitasking</strong>: Excellent time management skills with the ability to set priorities, multitask, and meet deadlines. Our producers are working on multiple projects simultaneously, and projects might touch different surfaces each time.</li> </ul> <h2>Our humble expectations </h2> <ul> <li><strong>Solid Production Experience:</strong> 8+ years in creative production or integrated campaign management, ideally within a high-growth tech environment or a progressive digital agency.</li> <li><strong>Understanding of Media Plans</strong>: You have experience with specs and asset production across Awareness, Consideration, and Conversion layers. </li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Management:</strong> Ability to manage complex projects with multiple high-level stakeholders while maintaining high creative standards. Demonstrated success partnering with distributed teams across time zones and cultures</li> <li><strong>Risk Management & Reporting</strong>: Ability to assess risks during production, find solutions, and share with management and stakeholders in a timely manner. </li> <li><strong>Organizational skills</strong>: Methodical in following a predetermined system to complete tasks and meticulous in paying close attention to small details without losing sight of the big picture.</li> <li><strong>Strong work ethic and accountability</strong>: A proactive attitude and rigor on everyday tasks, a positive mindset despite ongoing changes, and an excitement to learn. Resourceful during productions; deciding and acting on whether to bring external and/or internal resources and self-motivated to lead the project to completion. Someone who doesn’t shy away from a challenge and follows through on commitments made.  </li> <li><strong>Tech-Forward Mindset:</strong> You have a strong interest (and ideally experience) in AI-powered creative tools and generative workflows.</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Shape the Future:</strong> You won’t just be filling a seat; you’ll be building the blueprint for how Wolt produces creative content for years to come.</li> <li><strong>Innovation at Scale:</strong> Work at the forefront of AI and automation in the creative industry, moving from manual tasks to agentic workflows.</li> <li><strong>Impact:</strong> Take ownership of strategic business priorities and see your work scale globally.</li> <li><strong>Wolt Culture:</strong> Join a team that values ownership, heart, and a "get things done" attitude in a hybrid, flexible work environment.</li> </ul> <h2>Next steps</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Application Review:</strong> Our Production team will review your profile to see if your experience aligns with our strategy.</li> <li><strong>TA Screen:</strong> A 30-minute introductory call to discuss your background and motivations.</li> <li><strong>Hiring Manager Interview:</strong> A deep dive into your production philosophy with our Creative Production Lead.</li> <li><strong>Loop: Competency & Operating Principles: </strong>a structured behavioural interview with the team.</li> <li><strong>Working Session:</strong> a short case study and walk us through your thinking.<br><br><iframe style="display: table; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/GoL541_xj9w" width="720" height="404"></iframe></li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.</span></p> <p><em>Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at <span class="_80om1qgj _1e0c1nu9" data-testid="smart-link-draggable-inline"><span class="loader-wrapper"><span class="hover-card-trigger-wrapper" data-testid="hover-card-trigger-wrapper"><a class="_1yt4x7n9 _2rko1ssi _v56415x0 _1e0c1nu9 _16d9qvcn _syaz13af _1rkwglyw _4cvx1w55 _19itia51 _bfhkhp5a _1a3b18uv _4fprglyw _5goinqa1 _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _uizt1kdv _nt751r31 _49pcglyw _1hvw1o36 _1372tlke _7ehiw5lj _1j5pglyw _1di615s3" href="https://careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness" data-testid="inline-card-resolved-view"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw _o5721jtm _1nmz9jpi _16d9qvcn _ca0qv77o _u5f31b66 _n3tdv77o _19bv1b66" data-testid="inline-card-icon-and-title"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw">Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash</span></span></a></span></span></span> .</em></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Apply now and define the future of work!</span></div></div><h2>What this job can offer you</h2> <p>As a critical extension of our clients’ HR teams, we navigate and advise on the intricate paths of global employment with unmatched speed, expertise, and precision. employee Lifecycle team, the Specialist is also expected to contribute to process improvements and initiatives in line with Remote's strategic goals and values.</p> <h2>Key Responsibilities</h2> in offboarding activities and audits, including but not limited to payroll, legal counsel, government bodies, and trade unions.</li> <li>Draft, tailor and administer all termination and supplementary documents with accuracy and attention to detail, ensuring employee records are maintained with strict adherence to privacy and confidentiality regulations.</li> <li>Process offboarding on Remote's employee exit are administered correctly and promptly.</li> <li>Be the subject-matter expert and respond to internal and external queries on all offboarding matters in conjunction with Lifecycle's internal stakeholders.</li> <li>Navigate clients through Remote's Employee Relations resources and guides, helping them understand applicable policies and processes.</li> <li>Conduct preliminary assessment of workplace concerns, identifying key facts and applicable local regulations.</li> <li>Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure appropriate handling of employee relations matters.</li> <li>Support clients in understanding progressive disciplinary approaches and documentation requirements.</li> <li>Monitor ongoing employee relations cases, ensuring timely follow-up and coordination with relevant stakeholders.</li> <li>Actively identify opportunities for and contribute to process improvements, automation, product development and overall customer and employee experience through the offboarding and employee relations processes.</li> </ul> <h2>Key Requirements and Charactristics</h2> <ul> <li>Experience as a HR Advisor or HR Business Partner, with communication, influencing, conflict management, and negotiation skills, with the ability to confidently lead difficult conversations to a positive outcome, often where parties have conflicting interests, maintaining professionalism and strict confidentiality.</li> <li>Business-level (advanced) proficiency in written and spoken English, with additional languages considered a plus.</li> <li>Aptitude and appetite to innovate and optimize processes, continuously identifying and implementing opportunities for automation and championing best practices.</li> <li>Efficiency in operations, with an awareness of the importance of thorough record-keeping and data integrity.</li> <li>Tech-savvy, with the ability to successfully collaborate asynchronously on various tools, and adapt to new and evolving systems.</li> <li>Ability to work autonomously and cohesively in an international team in a fast-paced, asynchronous, remote environment with multiple priorities. Willingness to work flexible hours as needed.</li> <li>Proactive and self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.</li> <li><strong>Demonstrates strong automation and AI capabilities and AI fluency.</strong></li> </ul> <h2>Practicals</h2> <ul> <li><strong>You'll report to: </strong>Manager Employee Lifecycle, Employee Relations & Transitions</li> <li><strong>Team: </strong>Lifecycle, Employee Relations & Transitions</li> <li><strong>Location</strong>: EMEA</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Application process</strong></h2> <ol> <li>Interview with recruiter</li> <li>Take Home Exercise</li> <li>Interview with future manager</li> <li>Interview with team members (no managers present)</li> <li>Interview with Senior Manager</li> <li>Bar Raiser</li> <li><a href="https://www.notion.so/Veremark-Remote-96e108c037b8423cbd4c3f07a1f9b38b?pvs=21">Prior employment verification check</a></li> </ol> <p> </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Remote's <a href="https://www.notion.so/remotecom/people-Total-Rewards-1945bce8d3924ece9421ba8630f57b0c">Total Rewards philosophy</a> is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair <span class="link-annotation-unknown-block-id-1691622878">equity</span><span class="discussion-level-1 discussion-id-f2a82bc4-09e4-4a71-ad93-755b1d26a690 notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="3"> pay </span>along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. description: <div class="content-intro"><h1><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>About Workato</strong></span></h1> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit <a class="link" href="https://www.workato.com/" data-tooltip-link-label="undefined">workato.com</a>.</span></p> <h1><strong>Why join us?</strong></h1> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a </span><strong>flexible, trust-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">. We are driven by </span><strong>innovation </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">and looking for</span><strong> team players </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">who want to actively build our company. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">But, we also believe in </span><strong>balancing productivity with self-care</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">. That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment </span><a href="http://www.workato.com/careers"><span style="font-weight: 400;">along with a multitude of benefits</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Also, feel free to check out why:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"> <p><a href="https://www.businessinsider.com/47-enterprise-startups-to-bet-your-career-on-in-2020-2019-12"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Business Insider</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on”</span></p> </li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"> <p><a href="https://www.forbes.com/cloud100/#a57477b5f941"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Forbes’ Cloud description: Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. Enpal Energy is Enpal’s electricity division, making clean energy accessible to every household—from Germany’s most affordable electricity rates to smart energy solutions that optimally integrate generation, storage, and consumption. With ambitious growth targets and a rapidly expanding customer base, we are building a team that is actively shaping the German energy market. In doing so, we combine startup agility with the scale of a market leader—across all areas, from operations and technology to finance, customer support, and product development. What you'll do Model clean, well-documented datasets in dbt (staging → marts), including tests, ownership, and clear metric definitions. Lead the development and evolution of our semantic layer - defining governed business metrics, dimensions, and data contracts that serve as the single source of truth to downstream AI tools. Structure dbt models, metric definitions, and documentation so they are machine-readable and ready to serve as reliable context for AI-powered analytics tools. Diagnose messy or ambiguous source data, reconcile inconsistencies, and align stakeholders on a single source of truth. Optimize Snowflake query performance, data freshness, and quality through testing and monitoring. Partner with BI and business teams to design certified datasets, dashboards, and self-service standards. Develop reporting end-to-end — from understanding business needs to delivering actionable, intuitive data products. Maintain and evolve central data pipelines, dbt models, and Tableau integrations within a modern stack (Python, AWS/Azure/GCP, Git). Act as a technical mentor for the team, helping others adopt best practices in analytics engineering and embrace new tooling - including AI-assisted development. What you'll bring 5+ years of experience as an Analytics Engineer, BI Developer, or Data Engineer. Proven record of turning complex, large-scale data into actionable insights and governed metrics used across BI. Expert in SQL and data modeling (star schemas, dimensions/facts, semantic layer design). Hands-on experience building production-grade dbt projects with testing, documentation, and version control workflows. Strong proficiency in Python for analytics tasks (data checks, automation, utilities). Strong stakeholder management and communication skills — able to translate business logic into durable, scalable data models. Familiarity with ELT concepts, CI/CD for analytics code, data cataloging, and basic cost/performance tuning. Self-starter with a hands-on, problem-solving mindset, comfortable balancing autonomy and collaboration in a fast-moving environment. Genuine curiosity about how AI is reshaping the analytics engineering role - comfortable experimenting with AI-assisted development tools and motivated to help the team adopt them thoughtfully. Experience with or strong interest in semantic layer tooling (dbt MetricFlow, Snowflake semantic views, or similar) and how it enables both self-service analytics and AI-ready data products. title: Werkstudent:in Product Management (m/w/d)

title: Full Stack Engineer (m/f/d)
description: TL;DR Join GlassDollar and help build the system some of Europe's largest companies use to find, test, and adopt startup technology. We're looking for an engineer who wants considerably more responsibility than "implement what's in the ticket". You'll take an ambiguous problem, shape it together with product, make the important technical decisions, ship it, and stay close enough to see whether it worked. We expect you to have opinions. We also expect you to be good enough to change them. The problem we're solving Large organisations are remarkably good at accumulating problems. A company with 100,000 employees can have thousands of operational challenges across its business units. Somewhere outside that organisation, a startup has probably already built part of the solution. Getting those two things to meet still happens through spreadsheets, long email threads, and meetings whose primary output is another meeting. GlassDollar OS is the operating system for venture clienting: problem → startup discovery → evaluation → PoC → adoption, in one repeatable workflow. Our customers are some of Europe's largest organisations, so the software has to move quickly and behave like something an enterprise can depend on. That tension creates the interesting engineering problems. What we're looking for You can take a problem further than the ticket. Work often starts with something incomplete, like "customers need a better way to manage X". You'll shape the problem with product, challenge assumptions, and decide what belongs in this iteration. Strong opinions about what we build, not only how, are expected here. You care about product. You want to know who you're building for, why the problem matters, and what success looks like. That context should shape your technical decisions. You have technical judgement. There is rarely one correct architecture. You know when the boring solution beats the ambitious one, when an abstraction helps and when it hides the problem, and when a small feature is about to create six months of technical debt. We expect you to reason about API boundaries, data models, permissions, performance, failure modes, testing, observability, and rollout, and to raise concerns with a clear argument attached. You make the system better, not just the feature. You fix the spreading pattern rather than the single instance, make an API easier for the next person, and improve tests because the current setup makes everyone afraid to deploy. Your impact should show beyond the pull requests with your name on them. You can work across the stack. A feature might run from a React interaction through GraphQL into a Node service, a schema redesign, a permissions update, and a safe migration for existing customers. Curiosity to follow the problem matters more than equal depth everywhere. You own quality. We have QA. That's not where quality begins. What breaks if this request happens twice? What happens with old data, or when the API fails halfway through? We use Playwright and Jest alongside reviews and monitoring. The goal isn't coverage, it's confidence. You communicate like your decisions will matter later. Six months from now, somebody should understand an important decision without digging through seventeen Slack messages and a deleted Notion comment. That means writing things down when they matter, explaining trade-offs clearly, giving useful code reviews, and surfacing risks before they become incidents. You raise the engineering bar around you. You do not need a management title to have influence. Find the hole in an architecture, unblock someone without taking the keyboard away, disagree without turning every decision into a referendum. As you earn trust, you’ll naturally become the person people bring harder problems to. What you'll do Over your first year: Enterprise integrations: into our customers' systems, data, identity providers, and workflows. This is what turns GlassDollar from software somebody logs into, into infrastructure their organisation operates on. APIs and MCP: public REST APIs and MCP servers for our customers, their engineers, and increasingly their AI agents. The interesting part isn't exposing endpoints, it's designing an external platform we'll still be happy supporting years from now. AI inside real workflows: embeddings, vector search, and LLMs across a large database of startups and corporate innovation data. We're less interested in adding a ✨ button to everything than in finding places where AI removes real work. Workflow automation: triggers, notifications, and automation that replace humans moving information between systems. Core product engineering: React interfaces, APIs, PostgreSQL queries, permissions, migrations, performance work, and the occasional bug whose root cause makes everybody stare silently at their screen. Our stack Frontend: TypeScript, React, Material UI, Apollo Client, Playwright Backend: Node.js, GraphQL, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Jest Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Sentry Increasingly: LLM APIs, embeddings, vector search, MCP, AI-assisted engineering workflows You don't need experience with every item. Reasoning about systems matters more to us than having memorised our exact stack. Requirements Substantial production experience with TypeScript, React, and Node.js Comfortable reasoning about relational databases, not just the ORM Can independently take a feature from unclear starting point to production Can read unfamiliar code without immediately proposing a rewrite Nice to have: Experience with GraphQL, Prisma, or PostgreSQL at scale Exposure to LLM APIs, embeddings, or vector search Experience owning systems, not just features Don't check every box? Apply anyway. We'd rather have the conversation than lose someone over a bullet point. How we hire How we work We're a small engineering team, so there are fewer places for responsibility to disappear and no chain of five people between you and a decision. We prefer written context over meetings the calendar invented, and working software over elaborate process. Quickly doesn't mean carelessly. Sometimes the fastest route is the simple version today, sometimes it's another day on a foundation twenty future features will sit on. Knowing which situation you're in is part of the job. Expect to ship to production very early. How we hire No seven-stage endurance test. No algorithm trivia disconnected from the work. Intro. You, us, and whether this is the environment you're actually looking for. Technical conversation. We go deep on something difficult you've built: the decisions, the alternatives, what you'd do differently now. Technical assessment. Usually live coding on a realistic problem, sometimes a small proof of concept instead. We care how you think, not whether your solution matches ours. Offer. If there's strong mutual conviction, we move. One last thing Job descriptions have a habit of producing candidates who optimise themselves against bullet points. Please don't. If you're reading this thinking "I can do most of this, but I haven't worked with MCP", apply. Strong fundamentals, meaningful software shipped, and a bias toward ownership are what we're looking for. The rest is learnable. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Associate Product Owner

title: Computational Biologist

In particular, you will: Contribute analyses to projects aiming to discover novel drug targets, biomarkers and disease subtypes through reverse translation based on multi-omics patient or pre-clinical data including: genomic, transcriptomic (spatial, single-cell, bulk), proteomic, and others. analyze biomedical datasets using classical or novel omics methods and machine / deep learning algorithms Conduct literature reviews to stay up-to-date with respect to relevant approaches and datasets Participate in the interpretation of results and help design validation strategies together with cross-functional teams. Collaborate with other members of Owkin’s R&Tech and Biomedical departments with varied backgrounds (computational biologists and chemists, AI scientists, medical imaging experts, medical doctors, biologists, …). Participate in Owkin’s internal R&D activities, develop new as well as improve existing methodologies, strive to keep Owkin’s Toolbox to the state-of-the-art. And: Be passionate about the potential for impact when combining AI and healthcare. MSc / PhD in either computational biology, bioinformatics, biology, machine learning, computer science, mathematics or a related field. Experience working with omics data and NGS data processing pipelines. Experience of integrating multi-omics datasets. Experience of working in early-stage drug discovery programs, and with tasks such as target identification, biomarker discovery and patient stratification. Good knowledge about molecular and cellular biology, especially related to cancer and/or other human diseases, to help interpret analyzis results together with our biomedical experts. Familiarity with machine learning concepts and toolkits such as: cross validation, statistical tests, scikit learn, xgboost, etc. Experience using autonomous AI agents and agentic workflows to perform data analyses. Good programming skills in Python. Fluency in written and spoken English. Ways to Stand Out The following experience is not necessarily required, but would be a plus: Single-cell RNA-seq and spatial transcriptomic data analysis. Clinical and biomedical imaging data. Hands-on experience with agentic AI systems and their development. History of publications or contributions to top-tier academic journals or conferences. Social Media & Community - Steering our presence across existing Social media channels and new ones, while building an influencer strategy that extends our reach and relevance. Brand Strategy & Insights - Shaping and safeguarding brand identity, and grounding decisions in research and listening, including surveys with both customers and non-customers. Leadership & Team Rituals - Building and mentoring the team behind these pillars, establishing clear creative rituals (design reviews, sprints, feedback loops) and tools to ensure efficient, high-quality output. Cross-functional Collaboration - Partnering closely with Growth and Product teams to align brand initiatives with acquisition goals, retention targets, and product launches. Performance-Driven Branding - Defining and tracking KPIs for brand awareness and consideration, ensuring that even the most "creative" projects are data-informed and contribute to Satispay's overarching OKRs. We're not looking for a caretaker of an existing setup. We're looking for someone who has built or transformed a function, made hard calls under pressure, and can say "here's the decision, here's why, here's what happened." 10+ years of experience - Proven track record in brand management or creative direction, ideally within fast-growing tech companies or top-tier creative agencies. Strong Technical & Visual Culture - Deep understanding of design systems, rebranding processes, and multi-channel campaign production (from social media to TV/OOH). A "Hands-on" Leader - You love to lead by example. You're not just a "manager of resources" but someone who can get into the details of a layout or a script to ensure excellence. Data-Informed Mindset - Ability to translate brand concepts into business objectives, utilizing KPIs and OKRs to measure impact and iterate quickly. Exceptional Communicator - Fluent in English, with the ability to simplify complex brand visions for internal stakeholders and external audiences alike. We recognise that exceptional leadership comes in many forms. If you believe you have the vision, experience, and drive to help us shape the future of money, we encourage you to apply. We value the unique perspectives and strengths that exceptional leaders bring, even if their experience doesn't align with every listed requirement. Why this is your place This is a unique opportunity to leverage your experience and leadership to make a profound impact on a company poised for significant future growth. We operate on a principle of reciprocity: significant strategic impact are met with meaningful rewards and opportunities. Own outcomes that reach millions . Lead functions where the results show up directly in the experience of 6.5M+ people and the businesses they pay every day. Operate in high-growth. You'll make high-stakes calls without waiting for perfect information, in an environment that changes fast as we launch and scale new products. Significant equity participation. Directly share in Satispay's success through a competitive Stock Option Plan designed to reward leadership and contribution to company growth and raise the bar for collective success.
