title: Director, People Operations & Total Rewards
description: 🌀 The Company Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action. Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action. At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative. As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future. 🎯 The Role We’re looking for a hands-on, globally experienced People leader and builder to help take Filigran’s People organization through its next stage of scale. Reporting to the Chief People Officer, you’ll lead our global People Operations, Payroll and Total Rewards capabilities across Europe, North America and APJ. With ~300 employees across 18 countries, the challenge is not simply to build more People infrastructure — it’s to build smarter infrastructure . You’ll help create a scalable, technology- and AI-first People operating model that combines strong regional execution with effective systems, automation, and agentic AI. This is a builder and player-coach role . You’ll be expected to challenge how work gets done, simplify before adding complexity, automate before adding headcount, and build the People capabilities needed to support Filigran’s next stage of growth. 💼 Your Responsibilities Lead and scale global People Operations , continuously building and improving the operating model, team and infrastructure required to support Filigran’s next stage of growth across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond. Lead and develop our regional People Ops and Payroll teams , creating clear accountability, strong regional expertise and consistent global execution, with a strong focus on employee lifecycle experience . Build and continuously optimize an AI-first People operating model through process automation that simplifies and systemizes repeatable work; agentic AI that autonomously handles complex, low-risk, multi-step workflows requiring reasoning, decisions and escalation; and an integrated People technology ecosystem that connects systems, workflows and data into scalable infrastructure. Own global payroll operations , working with internal specialists and external providers to ensure accuracy, strong controls and timely multi-country execution. Own global Total Rewards operations , including compensation cycles, benchmarking, benefits, equity reporting and vendor management, in partnership with the CPO on strategy. Oversee global employment compliance and mobility , including regional compliance, immigration, EORs and entity-related People requirements, leveraging local experts and counsel where appropriate. Use People data and insights to proactively identify organizational trends, risks and opportunities , translating them into practical actions for leaders and the wider People team. Support organizational design and workforce planning , bringing data, organizational insight and implementation capability to CPO-led decisions. Support managers on routine performance, employee relations, workforce matters and organizational change. Remain hands-on and execution-oriented , moving fluidly between team leadership, systems and agent design, process improvement and complex operational problem-solving. 🤝 Who You’ll Work With Chief People Officer — partnering closely on People priorities, Total Rewards strategy and the evolution of our global People operating model. People Operations, Payroll teams — leading and developing these capabilities globally. Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development and Employee Experience — partnering across the broader People organization. People Managers, Finance, Legal, and IT — partnering on employee matters, payroll, rewards, compliance, systems and global operations. External partners and advisors — including EORs, payroll and benefits providers, employment counsel and mobility partners. 🧬 Profile We’re Looking For 10+ years of progressive HR / People experience , with leadership across People Operations and Total Rewards . Proven experience helping scale a global B2B SaaS, cybersecurity or enterprise technology company from approximately 300+ employees through significant growth . Strong global experience across Europe, North America and APJ , including multiple entities, EORs and complex European employment environments. Significant experience across People Operations, payroll, Total Rewards, Systems, and Compliance , with a track record of building infrastructure for scale . Highly technology- and AI-oriented , with demonstrated experience using automation, AI agents and agentic workflows to redesign work and increase People team capacity. Strong systems, data and commercial mindset , able to connect People infrastructure, insights and decisions to business priorities. Strong people leader who builds high-performing teams through trust, clarity, development and accountability. High EQ and strong influencing skills — collaborative, low-ego and direct, with the ability to build credibility, challenge constructively and navigate complex dynamics. Hands-on, player-coach mentality , equally comfortable partnering with leaders and directly solving operational, systems and organizational problems in a fast-growing, global, remote-first environment. Fluent in English and French; additional languages are a plus. 🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job. We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company , and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation . You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem. ⭐ Be part of something bigger We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative. 💻 Work at the edge of what’s next We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice. 🌍 Global opportunity without borders Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us. 🧭 A culture grounded in CORE Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching. 💰 What you can expect Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen 🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture. At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or veteran status. What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from or how you identify. 🚀 Ready to Join Us? Apply now and help us build the future of the cybersecurity ecosystem, together. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Engineering Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><div id="message-list_1790155756.049469"> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Engineering Manager, Production Engineering - Observability</strong></span></div> <div> </div> <div><strong>An overview of this role</strong><br>You'll lead the globally distributed Observability team. The team builds and operates the metrics, logging, alerting, and capacity planning platforms that GitLab engineers use to understand <a href="http://GitLab.com" target="_blank">GitLab.com</a> and GitLab Dedicated. You'll help determine how the team collects, stores, queries, and acts on telemetry, balancing reliable signals with scale and cost.<br>In your first year, you'll guide improvements to Prometheus-based metrics pipelines, log ingestion and retention, alerting driven by service-level objectives (SLOs), and capacity forecasting. You'll work with Site Reliability Engineering, Product Engineering, and other Infrastructure Platforms teams to make it easier for engineers to observe the services they own. You'll also take part in incident response and help keep the team's on-call work sustainable.<br><strong>What you’ll do</strong></div> <ul> <li>Lead, hire, onboard, and develop a distributed engineering team working asynchronously.</li> <li>Set priorities with Site Reliability Engineering, Product Engineering, and GitLab Dedicated teams, and help the team deliver observability services iteratively.</li> <li>Own the reliability, scalability, and cost of the team's metrics, logging, alerting, and capacity planning platforms.</li> <li>Reduce noisy or missing alerts and telemetry gaps, and use SLOs, error budgets, and self-service instrumentation to help engineers maintain the health of their services.</li> <li>Guide technical decisions about time-series storage, high-cardinality metrics, log pipelines, and distributed tracing.</li> <li>Participate in the Incident Manager On Call (IMOC) rotation, coordinating the response to high-severity incidents affecting <a href="http://GitLab.com" target="_blank">GitLab.com</a>.</li> <li>Keep the team's on-call rotation sustainable through coverage across time zones, useful runbooks, better alerts, and follow-through on post-incident actions.</li> <li>Use AI tools and agents to support engineering workflows and incident triage, reviewing their output while engineers retain responsibility for decisions.</li> </ul> <div><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></div> <ul> <li>Experience leading an observability, platform engineering, or site reliability engineering team operating at scale, including supporting people in a distributed, asynchronous environment.</li> <li>Technical knowledge of metrics systems such as Prometheus and long-term storage, logging platforms such as Elasticsearch or cloud-native services, and alerting design.</li> <li>Experience using SLOs, error budgets, and capacity forecasts to make reliability and investment decisions.</li> <li>Experience operating a large software-as-a-service platform and investigating production issues such as telemetry gaps, ingestion limits, or noisy and missing alerts.</li> <li>Experience participating in and improving production on-call rotations, including incident coordination and balancing operational load with project work.</li> <li>The ability to explain technical tradeoffs to engineering partners and other stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience using AI tools or agents in engineering or management work; you can describe how you would apply them to operational problems such as incident triage.</li> </ul> <div>We welcome different paths into this role, whether through practical experience, formal study, or transferable skills. If the work interests you, please apply even if you don't meet every qualification.</div> <div> </div> <div><strong>About the team</strong><br>We're part of Production Engineering within Infrastructure Platforms and work asynchronously across regions. Our tools include Tamland, the capacity forecasting tool. We bring lessons from operating GitLab's production systems back into the platforms we build.</div> <div> </div> <div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

You’ll sit in the room with senior client stakeholders, including CMOs, and turn their challenges into operating models, workflows and commercial models (team shapes, asset rates, outcome-based structures) that we can deliver. You’ll bring the commercial judgement to validate the numbers, the process thinking to design better ways of working, and the technical and channel knowledge to lead the conversation when specialists aren’t there. Quick on your feet and calm under pressure, you’ll be supported by our Commercial and Implementation teams.</p> <h4> </h4> <h4>Key Responsibilities:</h4> <h4>New Business and Client Engagement</h4> <ul> <li>Lead the operational and solution design element of new client pitches, presenting with credibility and confidence to senior client stakeholders, including CMOs and marketing leadership.</li> <li>Formulate solutions in real time during pitches, workshops and challenging client discussions, staying composed and commercially sharp.</li> <li>Own the conversation on technology and data when technical specialists aren’t present, and know when and how to bring them in.</li> <li>Ensure a smooth handover from pitch to implementation, so what we sell is what we deliver.</li> </ul> <h4>Requirement Gathering and Analysis</h4> <ul> <li>Work with stakeholders to gather, document and analyse business requirements for new client accounts.</li> <li>Ask the right questions to define accurate scope, cost and risk.</li> <li>Translate client business needs into workflows for client and technology teams.</li> </ul> <h4>Operating Model and Solution Design</h4> <ul> <li>Define and articulate operating model principles (roles, governance, ways of working, handoffs) that align to client goals and our delivery capability.</li> <li>Evaluate existing client and internal processes, identify new ways of working, and recommend improvements for efficiency, cost reduction and better outcomes.</li> <li>Design solutions across advertising and marketing channels, drawing on a strong understanding of how media, data, creative and technology fit together.</li> <li>Collaborate with technology and business teams to ensure solutions align with our strategy and are technically feasible.</li> </ul> <h4>Commercial Modelling</h4> <ul> <li>Build, test and validate commercial models that deliver the designed workflow, including team shapes, asset-based rate models and outcome-based models.</li> <li>Work with Commercial and Finance to pressure-test assumptions, margins and risk before models go to clients.</li> <li>Balance client value with commercial viability, and explain the reasoning clearly to both internal and client audiences.</li> </ul> <h4>Stakeholder Communication</h4> <ul> <li>Act as the bridge between clients, commercial, technology and delivery teams, ensuring shared understanding and alignment.</li> <li>Translate complex technical and commercial concepts into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical, senior audiences.</li> </ul> <h4>Data, Measurement and Reporting</h4> <ul> <li>Analyse data to support decision-making, and define measurement frameworks for new clients.</li> <li>Create reports and presentations that convey findings and recommendations with clarity and impact.</li> </ul> <h4> </h4> <h4>About You:</h4> <h4>Essential</h4> <ul> <li>10-15 years’ experience in solution design, consulting, strategy, operations or a similar role within advertising, marketing, media or marketing technology.</li> <li>A confident, articulate communicator with a track record of presenting to and influencing C-suite and senior marketing stakeholders (CMOs or equivalent).</li> <li>Commercial acumen, with hands-on experience building and validating pricing or commercial models (e.g. resourcing/team-shape models, rate cards, outcome-based or performance-linked structures).</li> <li>A process-driven mindset, able to map, challenge and redesign ways of working and articulate clear operating model principles.</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of advertising and marketing channels (e.g. paid media, social, programmatic, search, CRM, creative production) and how they connect to data and technology.</li> <li>Enough technical fluency in martech, adtech, data and platforms to hold credible conversations with clients and lead when technical specialists aren’t in the room.</li> <li>Quick-thinking and resilient, comfortable recommendations.</li> <li>Willingness and flexibility to travel regularly for client pitches, mostly across Europe and occasionally further afield.</li> </ul> <h4>Desirable</h4> <ul> <li>Experience title: Consultant
description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. Location This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with occasional visits to customers across the DACH region. As team collaboration is of great importance to us, we highly encourage team members to join us in Zurich at least once a month. These visits are financially supported by BLP. About the role For a process to run autonomously, four things have to line up: the technology, the process itself, the data behind it, and the people who work with it. That alignment does not happen at go-live. It happens in the months after, and that is where this role sits. Our customers go live with a working solution. What they do not have on day one is an organisation that operates in an AI-native way. Processes were designed around people checking things. Data was maintained well enough for humans to interpret. Teams know the old workarounds better than the new system. Your job is to lead that transition, from a process that is automated in parts to a process that genuinely runs on its own. That means working across every level of the customer's organisation. With operational teams you build understanding and find where automation is actually blocked. With department leads you challenge the process rules that make full automation impossible, and drive the decisions that change them. And you use the right lever for each blocker, because they are all different: some are a data clean-up you coordinate with the customer, some are a training and adoption gap, some need a custom agent, and some are structural and belong with our engineering teams. You do not do this alone. You enable the customer's core team to solve their own issues, you work with our Customer Success Engineers on the technical side, and you use the Customer Success Manager to get decisions made where you need commercial weight. For our smaller customers, where there is no Customer Success Manager, you are the escalation point yourself. You own customer health. Your sharpest measure of it is the automation rate. What you'll do Own customer health across your portfolio, measured first and foremost by automation rates. Lead the transition to AI-native ways of working: identify what blocks automation, and pick the right way to solve each blocker. Work with operational teams on enablement and adoption, so people work efficiently with blp rather than around it. Challenge process rules that prevent automation, and drive improvements with the department leads who can decide. Coordinate data clean-up with the customer where master data quality is capping what automation can reach. Enable the customer's core team to resolve issues themselves, and reduce what has to come to us at all. Identify where a custom agent solves the problem, and where the issue is structural and belongs with our engineering teams. Collaborate with Customer Success Engineers on technical topics, and with the Customer Success Manager to get decisions made. For customers without a Customer Success Manager, act as the escalation point for SLA breaches and own continuity of operations. Direct the AI Automation Specialists working on your accounts. What we're really looking for The following key attributes ensure success in this role: Process Excellence – You understand core business processes deeply, P2P and O2C, and you can see why a process is shaped the way it is and what it could look like instead. Client Hands – You bring customers with you. You are strict on the things that matter and flexible on the things that do not, you understand the context people are working in, and you have more than one way of convincing them. Ownership & Autonomy – You take a customer from live to high automation without being told the steps. Comfort in the Data – You go into the numbers yourself to find where automation is leaking. Problem Solving & Critical Thinking – You separate a configuration symptom from a process cause, and pick the right lever for each. What you'll bring Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 3+ years of experience in consulting, process improvement, shared services, or ERP process ownership. Deep working knowledge of at least one core business process end to end, purchase-to-pay or order-to-cash. This is a prerequisite, not a nice to have. Demonstrable experience changing how a finance, procurement or supply chain team actually works, not only advising on it. Strong analytical skills. You are comfortable working with process and transaction data directly. Confident facilitating workshops with operational teams and presenting to their leadership. Fluent in German and English, spoken and written. Bonus points for experience with ERP systems, accounts payable or order management processes, or AI-driven SaaS. What you'll get High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path. Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises. Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily. Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression. Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option programme. Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators. Technology exposure – be at the forefront of emerging technologies and enjoy continuous learning opportunities. Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites. Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact. Learn more about blp and our values at https://blp.digital/company/careers . Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Customer Success Engineer
description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. Location This is a full-time position based at our HQ in Munich or Cologne. About the role You solve the hard technical problems on live systems. Once a customer is running on blp, their processes are business critical. Invoices post or they do not. Orders flow or they sit. Our support organisation resolves most of what comes in, and a lot of it is genuinely well handled by people early in their career. What is left is yours: the cases where the cause is not obvious, where it crosses systems, data and process logic at once, where the same symptom has three possible explanations and only one of them is right. That is the job. Not a queue, and not the easy half of one. Everything difficult that comes out of the run phase lands with you. Two things sit alongside the case work, and they are what make this a senior job rather than a harder version of a junior one. Stabilising accounts When an account's health goes bad, you go in and stabilise it. Not as a permanent assignment, but as a small, highly skilled squad that takes a customer whose numbers or whose confidence have slipped, works out what is actually wrong across the whole picture, fixes it, and hands back a customer who is running properly again. It is the most concentrated version of this work there is. Taking effort out permanently Anything that keeps arriving in the queue is a signal, and the answer is usually not more people answering it. It might be better self-service for customers, a customer-facing assistant that resolves the routine questions before they reach us, better diagnostics, or a change in how something is configured at deployment so the problem never occurs. You are expected to find those, make the case, and drive them through. That is how a support organisation scales without scaling headcount one for one, and it is value the customer feels directly. You work across the boundary between what our platform does, what the customer's ERP does, and what their data actually looks like. You are the one who can read a failing case end to end and say what really happened, and then say credibly whether the fix is configuration, data, process, or a genuine product issue. When it is a product issue, you are the counterpart to our engineering and product teams: you bring the evidence, and because you have seen the same structural problem across several customers, your case is the one that moves the roadmap. You are also how this function gets better rather than just bigger. The diagnostic tooling, the patterns, the documentation that lets a first-year person resolve what used to take a senior one: that is yours to build. And the interns and specialists coming through the team learn this craft from you. You do not deliver integrations and you do not run go-lives. Our integrations engineers and technical project managers own that. You own what happens once it is live and it is challenging. What you'll do Own the technically difficult cases from our live customer base, end to end, to a verified root cause. Diagnose across boundaries: platform behaviour, ERP behaviour, master data and process logic. Decide what the real fix is, and make it: configuration, data, process, or a case for engineering. Go into accounts with a deteriorating health score, diagnose across the whole picture, stabilise them and hand them back running properly. Drive strategic initiatives that permanently reduce effort and improve the customer experience, from better diagnostics to customer-facing self-service and assistants. Act as the counterpart to Product and Engineering, with evidence strong enough to change priorities. Recognise structural problems across customers and push for them to be solved once. Build the diagnostic tooling, patterns and documentation that raise what the rest of the team can resolve alone. Mentor interns and earlier-career colleagues, and raise the technical bar of the function. Support Consultants and Customer Success Managers on the technical substance of customer escalations. What we're really looking for The following key attributes ensure success in this role: Root Cause, Not Symptom – You are not finished when it stops happening. You are finished when you know why. Cross-Boundary Reasoning – You hold platform, ERP, data and process in your head at once and find where the truth is. Credible Both Ways – You explain the same problem to an engineer and to a CFO, and both of them believe you. Leverage – Your instinct is to remove the next hundred cases, not only to close this one. You would rather build the thing that makes a problem stop arriving. Calm Under Escalation – When a business-critical process is stopped, you get more precise rather than faster. Stabilizer Under Pressure : An unhappy client is not a fire to put out. It is a relationship to rebuild. You bring the temperature down, put structure back into the account, and align next steps so trust returns, not just silence What you'll bring Master's degree in a STEM field: computer science, engineering, information systems, mathematics, physics or similar. Strong candidates from a related field are welcome to make their case. 3+ years in a technical customer-facing role: application support at depth, technical consulting, solution engineering, integration engineering or equivalent. Demonstrable debugging ability across systems, not only within one. APIs, data mapping, interfaces, logs. Comfortable with data. SQL or equivalent, and the instinct to check rather than assume. German and English, both fluent. This is a hard requirement. Our customers work in German every day and our internal work runs in English. Nice to have: ERP experience with SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or similar, scripting in any language, or exposure to workflow automation and process mining. What you'll get The hard problems, not the queue. Influence on the product, with a direct line to Engineering and Product. Room to shape the function, since the practice is still being built. Real growth – the path from here leads into Consulting, technical leadership within Customer Success, or Product. Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option programme. Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators. Visits & offsites – including collaborative team offsites. Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact. Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers . Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. Location This is a six-month internship based in Munich or Cologne. This is an in-person role. You learn this job by sitting next to people who already do it, and that does not work remotely. About the role Think of this role as the modern Sherlock Holmes — new puzzles to solve and new people to work with, every single day. This role sits exactly at the intersection of technology and business, and that is not a figure of speech. On one side you are in the system, in the data, working out what actually happened. On the other you are on a call with a finance team explaining it and agreeing what to do. You need both, every day. Our customers run their finance and supply chain processes on blp. When something does not behave the way they expected, a document that did not post, an exception that should have resolved itself, a number in a dashboard that looks wrong, they write to us. That is where your work starts, and it is also where you become the face of blp for that customer. What reaches them is you: your answer, your explanation, your judgement about what to do next. You will not be reading from a script and escalating. You investigate what the system did, what the data says and what the customer's process actually requires. You have the access and the authority to change configuration when that is the answer. And when it is not, you know who to bring in and what to give them. The role grows with you. You start on cases where the pattern is known and someone is close by. As your expertise builds you take the harder ones, and your exposure to customers grows with it: from written answers, to calls, to being in the room when a customer wants their most pressing problem solved now. This goes well beyond tickets. We are a fast-moving organisation and a lot of what needs to exist does not exist yet. You will take on and drive initiatives that make the whole operation scale: a recurring problem that should be solved once rather than fifty times, a piece of tooling that does not exist, a way of working that has outgrown itself. Interns here have shipped things that the team still uses. How we think about ownership You will be given real work with real consequences, early, because that is the only way anyone learns this job properly. The other half of that is judgement: explore and decide for yourself where you can, and pull someone in when something critical is on the line. Knowing which situation you are in is part of the skill, and nobody will hold it against you for asking. What matters is that you are the face of blp to that customer, and that you take that seriously. Most of our customers work in German and you will be in front of them from early on. That is uncomfortable for about three weeks and then it is the best part of the job. This is a real internship, not an observation post. You will be trusted with live customers quickly, with people close by while you learn. What you'll do Answer incoming customer requests through our support channel, and be the person they hear back from. Own incidents end to end: investigate, resolve, and confirm with the customer that it is actually fixed. Work out why a workflow, document or posting did not behave as expected. Adjust configuration where that is the right fix. Recognise when a problem is bigger than one case, and hand it on with proper evidence. Join customer calls to work through urgent issues directly, as your experience grows. Take on initiatives beyond the queue: things that should be fixed once rather than answered repeatedly. Document what you learn so the next person does not have to learn it twice. What we're really looking for We do not expect you to know ERP systems. We expect you to be the kind of person who gets to the bottom of things. Curiosity – You want to know why something works, not just that it does. Clear Logic – You take a messy situation apart, find the actual cause, and explain it simply. You will be bringing your regional technical expertise to aid the development of our asset integration technologies. The role is highly cross-functional: you'll bridge our software and hardware capabilities with the rigorous requirements of the four German Transmission System Operators (TSOs) and 900+ Distribution System Operators (DSOs). The detailed Gateway (Kraken’s IoT Edge Hardware&Software) configuration and protocol engineering is owned by our UK-based team, whom you will feed with regional knowledge and design input, and who will support you on the technical aspects of how Kraken integrations work. This can cover both new projects and retrofits. Regional Technical Expertise: Be the regional authority who feeds and supports the UK team with knowledge of German hardware requirements, industrial protocols, connectivity, cyber-security expectations, and TSO/DSO and ancillary-service requirements. Help evaluate hardware and connectivity solutions for regional fit. Stakeholder Liaison: Act as the technical point of contact for TSOs, DSOs, customers, and internal commercial teams to resolve connection, onboarding, or operational issues. Hardware & On-site Support (occasional): Hardware is deployed remotely in most cases via O&Ms and third parties. However, occasional regional support and hands-on intervention may be required before or after a deployment, including some hardware handling and on-site engineering. You’ll ideally be based close to Kraken’s Berlin office and the role requires the ability to travel when needed, though this is kept to a minimum. 🧠 What you'll bring to the party Language: Native or professional fluency in German and English , essential for technical documentation and TSO/regulator communication. Engineering background: Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control, or a related field ( or equivalent practical experience in industrial/energy integration). Integration & connectivity: Proven experience establishing industrial communication and connectivity between field equipment and external systems (telemetry and/or control). Power-plant systems: Working understanding of power-plant control systems and instrumentation, including metering. German market knowledge: TSO/DSO hierarchy and the connection/integration process. Ancillary services (FCR, aFRR, mFRR) prequalification and technical requirements. Redispatch 3.0 regulatory framework. Customer-facing delivery: Ability to produce technical integration approaches and communicate them to customers, regulators, and internal teams. Travel: Occasional travel may be required. A drive to get things done in a collaborative, agile environment , comfortable navigating the complexity of a multi-TSO, decentralised grid, and comfortable being the regional face of a technical function whose deep build sits with a partner team in the UK. ⭐️ Bonus points Knowledge of industrial communication protocols: IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61400-25 (wind), OPC-UA, Modbus , or similar IEC protocols. Understanding of IT/OT security in the energy sector ( NIS2, EnWG/KRITIS awareness ; IEC 62443 a plus). Familiarity with CLI tools for configuring, diagnosing, and maintaining hardware or network connections in remote, Linux-based environments. Familiarity with software languages, version-controlled configuration, and general tooling. Exposure to the wider European balancing markets / ENTSO-E frameworks beyond Germany. description: About Passionfroot Creator-led growth is one of the fastest-growing channels in B2B—and we’re building the infrastructure behind it. About the role We’re looking for a Senior or Staff Product Engineer to help build the next generation of Passionfroot. You’ll work across the full stack on both our core platform and Zest, our AI Campaign Manager for creator marketing. That could mean designing a new workflow for managing creator campaigns, making collaboration data feel instant, or turning models, search, and product context into a reliable AI experience that customers can trust. We don’t separate “AI engineering” from “product engineering.” AI is becoming part of how the product works, but great product fundamentals still matter: understanding the user, shaping the problem, choosing the right architecture, building a thoughtful experience, and operating it reliably in production. The flip side is real ownership: you need to exercise strong judgment, communicate your decisions, and think through their consequences rather than wait for someone else to catch them. 📍This role is based in our Berlin or São Paulo offices with a hybrid work model. What you’ll do Own meaningful product areas from problem definition through architecture, implementation, launch, and iteration. Build customer-facing features across our marketplace, campaign management, collaboration, payments, analytics, and creator workflows. Help make Zest an indispensable part of how modern companies run creator-led growth. Turn foundation models into structured, reliable product experiences—not just impressive prototypes. Work on intelligent workflows involving agents, tools, retrieval, search, recommendations, and generated interfaces. Develop the evaluations, observability, and feedback loops needed to understand whether AI features are genuinely useful. Work closely with design to create experiences that are fast, intuitive, and polished. Talk directly with customers and translate ambiguous needs into simple product decisions. Make pragmatic architectural choices that balance speed, quality, maintainability, and performance. Improve the systems and engineering practices that help a small team ship reliably at high velocity. At Staff level, provide technical direction across projects, raise the engineering bar, and help other engineers make better decisions. What we’re looking for Significant experience building and shipping high-quality, customer-facing software. 5+ years is a useful guide, but the scope and quality of your work matter more than the number. Strong TypeScript and React fundamentals, with experience working across the full stack. A track record of independently driving complex features or products from an ambiguous starting point to measurable customer impact. title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer / SRE – Kubernetes & Hybrid Cloud (m/f/d)
description: Introduction At a glance Location & work model : Berlin, hybrid Tech stack: Kubernetes on our own servers, Harvester ( KubeVirt ), Argo CD/Flux, Prometheus/Grafana, Longhorn/Ceph Team: A growing SRE team – you report to our CTPO for now and to the Team Lead SRE we're hiring next; two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware Process: Intro call · take-home task (~2h) · 90-min tech interview with our developers · leadership conversation · meet the team Languages: Fluent English required; German is a plus, not a must Why this role is special Most SRE jobs today mean clicking around a managed cloud console. This one doesn't. We run our own hardware in Frankfurt and are building a modern private cloud platform on Kubernetes and Harvester – on-prem by default, with elastic burst into the public cloud and the option to go cloud-only later. You won't inherit a finished SRE practice: you'll help define it, side by side with our Berlin development teams – and you won't do it alone, a Team Lead SRE hire is coming next. SRE here is an enabling discipline: you build what our developers need to ship reliably, while two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware. And the impact is direct – our product discovery technology powers more than 2,000 European online shops (Intersport, SPAR, Douglas and more), handling billions of shopper queries a year. When product discovery is slow or down, our customers lose revenue in real time. Your first 90 days You get to know both products, join the on-call rotation with a buddy, and own your first reliability topic – SLOs for one product, alerting that actually helps at 3 a.m., or automating away a piece of toil. By day 90 you've shipped visible improvements and know where you want to take the platform next. Your mission Define and own SLOs, SLIs and error budgets; drive data-informed reliability decisions Lead incident response end-to-end: fast detection, clear communication, blameless postmortems – and reduce whole classes of incidents structurally, not case by case Eliminate toil through automation and GitOps; evolve our observability (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, runbooks) across two different stacks Help build our custom Kubernetes operator (CRDs) that makes stateful search clusters declarative, self-healing and safely upgradable – and roll out the auto-scaling (HPA/VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler) today's architecture makes hard Plan capacity, performance and cost across on-premises and cloud – including the large-catalogue and peak-season loads our merchants care about – and use AI tools wherever they measurably speed up diagnosis and operations Your profile Must-haves: Kubernetes in production – built, not just used : you've set up and maintained clusters on your own servers (e.g. kubeadm , RKE2, k3s) and know cluster lifecycle and upgrades – managed-only experience isn't enough for this role Lived SRE practice : SLOs, error budgets, incident management, on-call Hands-on experience with GitOps or comparable infrastructure/deployment automation – experience with Argo CD or Flux is a strong plus Solid observability skills – metrics, logs, traces, alerting that people trust A strong automation instinct – you'd rather fix a problem's cause than repeat its workaround A collaborative, enabling mindset – you see SRE as a service to our developers: you ask what they need, discuss trade-offs openly, and don't fall in love with your own solution Nice-to-haves (genuinely optional – we'll teach you the rest): Harvester, KubeVirt , vSphere/ ESXi , OpenStack or similar virtualization/HCI platforms Container storage (Longhorn, Ceph) and datacenter networking (load balancing, ingress, VLAN) Auto-scaling (HPA, VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler ) and capacity/cost planning Experience building Kubernetes operators/CRDs German language skills Certifications (CKA, CKS) are welcome but no substitute for hands-on experience – in the tech interview we'll ask about what you've actually built and operated. You don't tick every box – or your title was never “SRE”? Apply anyway. If you've owned production systems, handled incidents and worked deeply with Kubernetes, we want to hear from you – production experience and engineering mindset matter more to us than titles or buzzwords. THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US Impact from day one: Your work directly influences the revenue of leading eCommerce brands across Europe. Modern tech stack: Kubernetes, Harvester, GitOps, auto-scaling, and an exciting path toward the cloud – with room to build things right. AI-first mindset: We use AI as a real part of our daily work, not as a buzzword. Ownership & growth: Clear responsibility, short decision paths, and the opportunity to actively shape your role. Flexible work: Hybrid work model three office days per week with a focus on outcomes. Strong team: Experienced engineers, an open feedback culture, and an environment where reliability is treated as a real engineering discipline. title: Senior Product Manager, Wealth & AI (f/m/d)
description: What we do At getquin, we're on a mission to empower everyone to build wealth. Founded in 2020, we started with a simple idea: help people see their entire financial life in one place, so they can make more informed decisions. Today, getquin has grown into one of the largest wealth platforms globally, already helping over half a million users manage and grow their wealth. Our platform combines analytics, tools and community to make wealth-building accessible for everyone, not just the experts. After launching in Germany, we've started expanding across Europe, with a focus on growing our user base, building valuable new features and helping even more people take control of their financial future. If you're excited to help shape the future of personal wealth management, join us. We're just getting started. What you'll be doing You've built products for investors. You know what a TER actually does to a long-run return, why a user with four brokers has no visbility what they really own, and how differently people behave when the number on screen is their pension rather than their pocket money. You've probably also hit the ceiling of what a chart can tell someone. Better tables, more filters, another allocation donut. The data was always there; the answer never quite arrived. We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. Your work is turning that into features and insights people understand and act on, and the interesting tools for doing that now include AI. We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own that area. You'll work directly with the founders and the product team, alongside engineering and our financial advisory teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and you'll mentor less experienced product managers on the team. Own the wealth product area end to end Set the product strategy and roadmap across the picture we give people of their wealth and how we help them optimize it Decide what we build on aggregated portfolio data that nobody with a single-broker view could build at all Own our efforts to stay on the forefront of digital wealth management services and play your part in disrupting a still very offline industry Work the unglamorous, high-leverage problems too: data quality, coverage gaps, missing cost basis, duplicate holdings across connections, ETFs held through more than one broker. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under it Turn the data into something users act on Define the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screen Own our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is which Set the quality bar for anything we tell a user about their money: accuracy targets, human review, guardrails, rollback. Decide when something is good enough to ship and hold that line when the pressure is to ship anyway Own the numbers Define the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retention Run the experiments, including proper A/B testing, read them, and report what didn't work alongside what did Live in your own product analytics and write your own queries and reporting, rather than wait for someone to give that to you What we are looking for You might be a fit if: You've built wealth management, investing or portfolio products. You know the domain properly: instruments, ETFs, costs, allocation, risk, tax drag, and how retail investors actually behave rather than how they should. title: Full Stack Product Developer (m/w/d)
description: Aufgaben Du willst Technologie gestalten, die direkt etwas bewegt? Bei Table.Briefings entwickeln wir digitale Produkte für ein wachsendes Medienunternehmen. Unsere Software hilft dabei, Prozesse effizienter zu machen, neue Geschäftsmodelle zu ermöglichen und unseren Redaktionen den Rücken freizuhalten – damit sie sich auf das konzentrieren können, was sie am besten können: hochwertigen Journalismus! Als dritter interner Entwickler bzw. dritte interne Entwicklerin übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in unserem Tech-Team. Du arbeitest an der gesamten Entwicklungskette: von der ersten Idee über Konzeption und Umsetzung bis zu Deployment, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung. Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, Features zu programmieren. Du hilfst uns, die richtigen Probleme zu erkennen, Anforderungen zu schärfen und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die für unser Business, unsere Nutzerinnen und Nutzer und unsere Redaktionen wirklich einen Unterschied machen. Deine Aufgaben Du konzipierst, entwickelst und betreust unsere Webanwendungen, APIs und Apps. Du arbeitest an unseren Statamic -basierten Plattformen und entwickelst unser CMS weiter. Du entwickelst neue Funktionen mit unserem bestehenden Tech-Stack und verbesserst bestehende Lösungen kontinuierlich. Du beschäftigst dich mit dem Einsatz und der Optimierung von Large Language Models und Coding Agents – zur Automatisierung interner Prozesse und für neue Produktfeatures. Du entwickelst und integrierst RESTful APIs, zum Beispiel zur Anbindung von Systemen wie ActiveCampaign . Du wirkst bei der Konfiguration, Wartung und Absicherung unserer Linux-Server und Deployment -Prozesse mit. Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus unterschiedlichen Bereichen in klare technische Lösungen. Du bringst Struktur in komplexe oder noch nicht vollständig definierte Aufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen umsetzbare Produkte werden. Du arbeitest eng mit Stakeholdern, Produktverantwortlichen, Redaktion und Geschäftsführung zusammen. Unser Tech-Stack - Wir arbeiten unter anderem mit: PHP und Laravel Statamic PostgreSQL Livewire HTML, CSS und JavaScript RESTful APIs Linux-Servern und modernen Deployment -Prozessen Large Language Models und Coding Agents Du musst unseren Tech-Stack nicht bereits vollständig beherrschen – wichtiger sind uns dein technisches Verständnis, deine Kommunikationsstärke und deine Fähigkeit, komplexe Anforderungen schnell in gute Lösungen zu übersetzen. Du solltest aber Lust haben, mit unseren Technologien zu arbeiten und dich schnell in neue Systeme und Themen einzuarbeiten. Wir suchen keine Person, die jedes Tool schon einmal eingesetzt hat, sondern jemanden, der gute technische Entscheidungen trifft, Zusammenhänge versteht und Verantwortung übernimmt. Qualifikation Du hast fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und beherrschst mindestens eine relevante Programmiersprache sicher. Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Webanwendungen, APIs und Datenbanken. Du interessierst dich für unseren Tech-Stack und hast Lust, dich in Laravel , Statamic , PostgreSQL und Livewire einzuarbeiten oder darin weiterzuentwickeln. Du verstehst, wie man LLMs und Coding Agents sinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll in der Softwareentwicklung einsetzt – oder möchtest es lernen. Du kennst dich mit Linux-Servern, Deployment und grundlegenden Fragen der IT-Sicherheit aus oder bist bereit, dich in diese Themen einzuarbeiten. Du kannst komplexe Probleme schnell erfassen, priorisieren und in konkrete nächste Schritte übersetzen. Du kommunizierst klar und gerne – auch mit Menschen, die nicht technisch arbeiten. Du kannst unterschiedliche Anforderungen und Perspektiven zusammenbringen und sicher mit Stakeholdern umgehen. Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert. Du behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn Anforderungen sich verändern, Informationen zunächst unvollständig sind oder mehrere Themen gleichzeitig auf dem Tisch liegen. Du hast Freude daran, in solchen Situationen Ruhe, Struktur und Verbindlichkeit zu schaffen. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind für die Kommunikation im Team und mit unseren Stakeholdern unerlässlich. Was uns wichtig ist Wir entwickeln nicht zum Selbstzweck. Unser Ziel ist Software, die unmittelbar Wirkung entfaltet: für unser Geschäft, für die Vervielfachung unserer Lizenzen und für unsere Redaktionen, die täglich anspruchsvolle Inhalte produzieren. Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Fragen stellt und sich aktiv einbringt. Du solltest dich in einem meinungsstarken, dynamischen Umfeld wohlfühlen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven aushalten und deine eigenen Ideen überzeugend vertreten können. Gleichzeitig ist uns wichtig, dass du pragmatisch bleibst und gemeinsam mit anderen zu guten Lösungen kommst. Benefits Wir bieten dir: Eine Schlüsselposition in einem innovativen und wachstumsstarken Medienunternehmen Die Möglichkeit, unseren Tech-Stack aktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln Viel Eigenverantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege Einen vielseitigen Job mit direktem Einfluss auf unser Business und unsere Produkte Eine unbefristete Festanstellung in Teilzeit oder Vollzeit 28 Tage Urlaub Flexibilität bei Arbeitszeit und Arbeitsort > Drei Tage pro Woche in unserem Büro in Berlin-Mitte, zwei Tage im MobileOffice Persönliche und fachliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einer echten Wachstumskultur Eine offene, freundliche Atmosphäre mit Partnerinnen, Partnern und Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus der ganzen Welt Deine Bewerbung Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein kurzes, persönliches Motivationsschreiben mit maximal 1.000 Zeichen: Warum möchtest du als Full Stack Product Developer (m/w/d) bei Table.Briefings arbeiten? Uns interessiert besonders, welche Probleme du gerne löst, wie du mit unterschiedlichen Anforderungen umgehst und was dich daran reizt, Technologie mit konkretem unternehmerischem und redaktionellem Nutzen zu entwickeln. We own pricing, contract lifecycle and Sales tooling. We have a direct impact on Alan’s margin and growth. 🔍 What we're looking for We're looking for an engineering leader who gets excited about building state-of-the-art AI systems and applying them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare. title: Commercial Account Executive, DACH
description: <div class="content-intro"><div><span id="m_8220454926977230902gmail-docs-internal-guid-9a9f34f4-7fff-014a-c97c-98ca90610a47">Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company's products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. The result is trusted customer experiences with stronger conversions for measurable business impact.</span></div> <div> </div></div><p>At Algolia, we are passionate about helping businesses connect their end-users with what matters most in milliseconds!</p> <p>As an Algolia Account Executive, you will be responsible for creating strong relationships with our customers/prospects and building on these relationships to expand our footprint or close new businesses. You should be comfortable researching prospective customers and adapting sales strategies to meet their needs. You will also play an integral role in defining our sales model. You know the ins and outs of Algolia, understand how we can benefit each prospect and will ultimately be the front line of our revenue growth in the German-speaking and CEMEA markets.</p> <p>Algolia has been growing exponentially over the past few years with Germany representing one of our core markets. We are now expanding our existing German-speaking team to further accelerate in this region, providing you with the opportunity to become one of the core players in our success story. You will be an important voice in how we address this market and able to gain a lot of visibility both within our fast-growing tech company as well as within the German eCommerce/ retail segment.</p> <p>Are you a resilient problem-solver who isn't afraid to think outside the box and get their hands dirty? We expect you to take ownership and be able to execute, defining your own territory strategy. We're looking for candidates who raise the level and bring sales excellence to the revenue organisation. You should value and practice transparency, have the humility to accept your weaknesses and continuously strive to improve both personally and professionally.</p> <h3><strong>YOUR ROLE WILL CONSIST OF:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Managing and growing a sales pipeline</li> <li>Driving inbound and outbound leads through complex sales cycles to closed won</li> <li>Working your network and collaborating with external partners to source and facilitate new projects in the Commercial segment</li> <li>Managing and prospecting with an existing account base to drive usage-based and feature-based upsells</li> <li>Generating new projects from booking self-driven outbound meetings</li> <li>Building compelling demonstrations with the pre-sales team, sales material and ROI studies bringing value to our customers</li> <li>Forecasting accurately to help the team hit their numbers</li> <li>Collaborating with sales developers, solutions engineers, customer success managers, legal, partner managers and marketing.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU HAVE:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>2 - 4 years of experience in a closing role (esp. in B2B, MarTech, SaaS tech sales)</li> <li>Excellent spoken and written German and English skills, Polish or Czech a plus</li> <li>Hunter mindset: Strong familiarity with outbound prospecting techniques, tools and processes</li> <li>Strong Plus: Experience in working with partners (solution integrators, consultancies, independent software vendors)</li> <li>Multi-tasker who can adapt to changing situations</li> <li>Quick thinker, must be able to handle questions on the fly</li> </ul> <h3><strong>NICE TO HAVE:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You love tech sales;</li> <li>You have a curious mindset and are capable to understand prospects’ pains and how a deep tech solution like Algolia can solve it;</li> <li>You thrive in dynamic environments and are capable to adjust to constant change;</li> <li>You are excited by the idea of building things and have a structured and strategic approach to working your territory;</li> <li>You believe you are in charge of your own success and you have the grit to continue going when things get challenging.</li> </ul> <p>#LI-Hybrid </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Algolia does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, military status, veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.</p> <p>The annual total cash compensation range (base salary and commission) for this role reflects market pay data within this location. The exact compensation offered for this role may vary depending on specific location and job-related knowledge, technical skills, and experience; and is only one part of our Total Rewards philosophy to compensate and recognize employees for their work.</p></div><div class="title">On-Target Earnings Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€120.000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€160.000 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>FLEXIBLE WORKPLACE STRATEGY:</strong></p> <p>Algolia’s flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolians to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. We place an emphasis on an individual’s impact, contribution, and output, over their physical location. Algolia is a high-trust environment and many of our team members have the autonomy to choose where they want to work and when. </p> <p>We have a global presence with offices in Paris, NYC, London, Sydney and Bucharest, however we also offer many of our team members the option to work remotely either as fully remote or hybrid-remote employees.<strong> Positions listed as "Remote" are only available for remote work within the specified country. Positions listed within a specific city are only available in that location - depending on the role it may be available with either a hybrid-remote or in-office schedule.</strong></p> <p><strong>WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO CAN LIVE OUR VALUES:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>GRIT</strong> - Problem-solving and perseverance capability in an ever-changing and growing environment.</li> <li><strong>TRUST </strong>- Willingness to trust our co-workers and to take ownership.</li> <li><strong>CANDOR</strong> - Ability to receive and give constructive feedback.</li> <li><strong>CARE</strong> - Genuine care about other team members, our clients and the decisions we make in the company.</li> <li><strong>HUMILITY</strong> - Aptitude for learning from others, putting ego aside.</li> </ul> <p>We’re looking for talented, passionate people to help build the world’s best search and discovery technology. We value autonomy, diversity, and collaboration. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected and supported—regardless of race, age, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, color, veteran status, disability, or socioeconomic background.</p> <p><strong>IMPORTANT NOTICE FOR CANDIDATES - Recruitment Fraud Notice</strong></p> <p>We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams targeting job seekers. To help protect yourself, please keep the following in mind:</p> <ul> <li>Our open positions may appear on third-party job boards, but the <strong>best way to apply safely</strong> is directly through our <strong>careers page</strong>.</li> <li>All genuine communication from Algolia will come from an ----- email address. If you receive an email from someone claiming to work at Algolia who does not have an ----- email address, please do not respond or share any personal information.</li> <li>We’ll <strong>never ask for payments, purchases, or financial details</strong> during the hiring process.</li> </ul> <p><strong>READY TO APPLY?</strong></p> <p>If you share our values and our enthusiasm for building the world’s best search & discovery technology, we’d love to review your application!</p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Key Account Manager
description: <p></p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(35, 111, 161);">Why Verifone</span></h2> <p>For more than 40 years Verifone has established a remarkable record of leadership in the electronic payment technology industry. Verifone has one of the leading electronic payment solutions brands and is one of the largest providers of electronic payment systems worldwide.</p> <p>Verifone has a diverse, dynamic and fast paced work environment in which employees are focused on results and have opportunities to excel. We take pride in the fact that we work with leading retailers, merchants, banks, and third party partners to invent and deliver innovative payments solution around the world. We strive for excellence in our products and services, and are obsessed with customer happiness. Across the globe, Verifone employees are leading the payments industry through experience, innovation, and an ambitious spirit. Whether it’s developing the next platform of secure payment systems or searching for new ways to bring electronic payments to new markets, the team at Verifone is dedicated to the success of our customers, partners and investors. It is this passion for innovation that drives each one of our employees for personal and professional success.</p> <p>Verifone is proudly an in-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co-located. Currently, we do allow a hybrid work schedule but we regularly revisit our attendance policy.</p> <p></p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(35, 111, 161);">What's Exciting About The Role</span></h2> <p><span style="color: rgb(35, 111, 161);"></span></p> <div>To ensure the long-term stability and growth of strategically important international customer relationships, we are hiring a <strong>Senior Key Account Manager</strong>. service delivery</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Contributing to forecasting, pipeline maintenance in Salesforce, and account reporting</span><span <p><strong></strong></p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(35, 111, 161);">Skills and Experience We Desire</span></h2> <p><strong></strong></p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{}"></span></p> <div> <ul> <li>Fluency in both German and English, with the ability to communicate effectively in both languages</li> <li>Extensive experience within the payments industry, with strong expertise in payment gateways, acquiring services, and payment terminal solutions.</li> <li>Proven track record in Key Account Management or Relationship Management, ideally within the payments, financial services, or retail sectors.</li> <li>Experience managing complex international customer organizations, including global and multi-market enterprise accounts.</li> <li>Proficiency in Salesforce and/or comparable title: (Junior) Finance Manager (German Speaking) (m/w/d)
description: DEINE ROLLE Zahlen sind für dich kein Selbstzweck, sondern die Grundlage guter Entscheidungen? Du willst kein kleines Rädchen in einer großen Finanzabteilung sein, sondern echte Verantwortung und tiefe Einblicke in die Abläufe eines FinTechs? Dann bist du bei uns richtig. Als (Junior) Finance Manager (m/w/d) arbeitest du in einem schlagkräftigen, kleinen Finance Team direkt mit dem VP Finance zusammen – und übernimmst von Tag eins an Verantwortung. Von der laufenden Buchhaltung über Monats- und Jahresabschluss bis zu Reporting, Forecasts und der Automatisierung unserer Prozesse deckst du die gesamte Bandbreite ab – und siehst unmittelbar, wie deine Arbeit bei Management, Investoren und Board ankommt. So entwickelst du ein tiefes Verständnis der finanziellen Steuerung eines der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter Europas – und prägst sie aktiv mit. Was machst du dabei konkret? Monatsabschluss: Du übernimmst eigenständig wiederkehrende Reporting- und Abschlussaufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass unser Monatsabschluss steht – pünktlich und verlässlich Jahresabschluss: Du bringst dich in die Vorbereitung des HGB Jahresabschlusses ein und unterstützt unsere Accountants und Wirtschaftsprüfer beim Audit. Reporting: Du erstellst KPIs und Finanzkennzahlen für Management-Präsentationen und wirkst an Investoren- und Board-Unterlagen mit. Analysen: Du baust Finanzmodelle, Forecasts und Abweichungsanalysen und machst aus Zahlen belastbare Insights. Prozessautomatisierung: Du digitalisierst und automatisierst unsere Finanzprozesse u.a. über AI Anwendungen – und findest die Tools, die uns morgen schneller machen. DAS BRINGST DU MIT Erfahrung & Qualifikation: Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung und/oder ein Studium. Erste praktische Erfahrung im Accounting/Controlling, Consulting, Investment Banking oder Venture Capital ist ein Vorteil. Analytische Fähigkeiten: Zahlen sind dein Zuhause: Du denkst analytisch, arbeitest sicher in Excel und findest dich schnell in Tools wie NetSuite, Abacum, Moss oder PowerPoint zurecht. Erfahrung mit Automatisierung und AI Tools ist ein Plus – vieles davon lernst du bei uns on the Job. Mindset: Du bringst eine proaktive, sorgfältige und detailorientierte Arbeitsweise mit und blühst in einem dynamischen, schnell wachsenden Startup Umfeld auf. Du bist ambitioniert, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und ziehst Dinge eigenständig durch. Sprache: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch (mindestens C1) und fühlst dich in einem internationalen Arbeitskontext wohl.
