Our culture is built on iteration,</p> <h2> </h2> <p><strong>Role Summary</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a talented Distributed Systems Engineer to join the Data Localization team. The team builds the infrastructure that enforces where customer data is stored, processed, and decrypted across one of the largest globally distributed edge networks in the world. The problem is not simply building fast, resilient distributed systems; it is building them with provable geographic boundaries that hold under failure, at the scale and reliability Cloudflare's customers depend on.</p> <h2> </h2> <p>You will work across the full stack in Go and Rust, from low-level policy enforcement and cryptographic key routing at the edge to customer-facing APIs and dashboards, on top of Cloudflare's existing infrastructure: the edge fleet, globally distributed key-value storage, Workers and Durable Objects, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, and regional ClickHouse. Features ship end-to-end: you will own the design, implementation, rollout, and production operation of the systems you build.</p> <p>This is a good fit if you are drawn to problems where compliance correctness is a hard constraint and not just a quality goal, and where the failure modes you reason about have real consequences for customers operating under regulatory scrutiny.</p> <h2><br><br></h2> <p><strong>Role Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, build, and operate backend services that enforce regional boundaries on where customer data is stored, processed, and decrypted, across a globally distributed edge network.</li> <li>Contribute to end-to-end feature delivery — write technical designs and RFCs, implement services and libraries, add tests and observability, drive rollout, and own the resulting systems in production.</li> <li>Partner with engineers on adjacent platforms, cryptography, networking, data, and product teams to integrate residency guarantees into new and existing surfaces without regressing performance or reliability for other customers.</li> <li>Reason carefully about failure modes, consistency, and blast radius; design systems that fail closed for compliance while degrading gracefully for availability, and make these tradeoffs explicit in design docs.</li> <li>Participate in on-call for your services, lead incident response and post-mortems, and continually invest in reliability, capacity planning, and cost.</li> <li>Raise the engineering bar through code review, mentorship, and clear written communication; contribute to the team's engineering standards and tooling.</li> </ul> <h2> </h2> <p><strong>Role Requirements (Must-Have Skills)</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of professional experience designing, building, and operating production distributed systems at scale.</li> <li>Strong proficiency in at least one system or backend language such as Go, Rust, or C/C++, and a willingness to work in others as the codebase demands.</li> <li>Solid grasp of distributed systems fundamentals, including:</li> <ul> <li>Consistency and consensus models (strong, sequential, eventual; Paxos / Raft at a conceptual level).</li> <li>Replication, sharding, and partitioning strategies, and their tradeoffs against availability and latency.</li> <li>Failure modes: partial failure, network partitions, split brain, clock skew, and how these show up in real systems.</li> <li>Idempotency, retries, backpressure, timeouts, circuit breakers, and rate limiting as first-class design concerns.</li> <li>Health checking, failure detection, leader election, and graceful degradation.</li> <li>Observability: metrics, logs, and tracing as design inputs, not afterthoughts.</li> ability to write clear design documents and collaborate effectively across time zones.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience building compliance-driven, Build Elite Teams. You and your team will be fully equipped with the absolute best-in-class AI tools and productivity platforms to eliminate admin work, optimize your coaching framework, and supercharge your GTM velocity.</li> <li><strong>Culture of Builders – </strong>We value autonomy, creativity, collaboration, operational excellence, and purpose-driven work.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p data-path-to-node="0">For Netherlands based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €248,000 - €341,000.</p> <p data-path-to-node="0">This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. Queues allows customers to send, buffer, and reliably deliver messages between Workers with at-least-once delivery, batching, and configurable delivery guarantees, without managing infrastructure or paying bandwidth egress fees. Deeply integrated with Cloudflare Workers, Queues supports event-driven and asynchronous applications across the Developer Platform. Generally available since September 2024, Queues runs at global scale on Cloudflare’s edge network and is a foundational building block for event-driven and asynchronous applications.</p> <p class="doc-paragraph">In this role, you will help design and build <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/queues/"><strong>Cloudflare Queues</strong></a>, improving reliability, performance, and delivery guarantees while shipping new features at global scale. the software development lifecycle.</li> <li>Strong judgment for when to rely on AI tools and when to validate independently.</li> <li>Strong ownership of correctness, security, and quality.</li> understanding of TypeScript/JavaScript.</li> <li>Strong systems-level programming skills.</li> <li>Understanding of security issues and responsibilities.</li> <li>Experience monitoring, alerting, and building APIs.</li> <li>Commitment to continuous learning and improvement.</li> </ul> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Provider APIs change weekly, new models appear constantly, and developer expectations are rising just as quickly. AI Gateway needs engineers who can build durable infrastructure in that environment without slowing down.</p> <p>We also believe AI should change how we build software, not just what we build. We dogfood AI Gateway, Workers AI, and Cloudflare’s broader agent stack heavily. and curiosity about how agents, tools, and automation can improve engineering productivity.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Bonus Points</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience building AI/ML infrastructure, inference platforms, model gateways, LLM-powered applications, or provider abstraction layers.</li> <li>Experience building developer-facing APIs, SDKs, CLIs, dashboards, or platform products at scale.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with proxy, edge, gateway, routing, or traffic management systems.</li> <li>Familiarity with the current AI ecosystem: model providers, model capabilities, agent frameworks, inference patterns, and the rough edges developers hit in practice.</li> <li>Experience with cost controls, rate limits, caching, retries, fallbacks, evaluation, or observability for AI harnesses, tools, or workflows that changed how you ship.</li> <li>You have built something with AI Gateway, Workers AI, or a competing product, and have opinions about what is missing.</li> <li>A Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Seoul, South Korea</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. title: Vulnerability Management Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Available Locations: </span></strong><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Austin (US), London (UK)</span></p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About the Role</strong></span></h2> <p>Reporting to the Vulnerability Manager, the VM  Engineer will be responsible for identifying, analysing, and supporting the remediation of vulnerabilities across Cloudflare's Infrastructure and cloud environments.You will work closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, cloud and compliance teams to identify, triage, and drive timely and effective remediation of security vulnerabilities in line with defined SLAs. A key focus of the role will be supporting DOD IL4 and Fedramp preparation, ensuring vulnerability processes, evidence, and tooling align with regulatory and assurance requirements. You will also apply AI-driven tools and methodologies to enhance scanning efficiency, triage accuracy, and automated remediation pathways. We are looking for a proactive, detail oriented individual with the ability to manage multiple remediation activities in parallel.</p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Responsibilities</strong></span></h2> <ul> <li>Conduct vulnerability scanning, and perform in-depth analysis of  findings from scanning tools (e.g., Qualys, Nessus, Rapid7), to verify accuracy, identify systemic patterns, and filter out false positives.</li> <li>Triage, validate and prioritise vulnerabilities using risk based approaches to determine real business impact, and working with engineering and compliance teams to agree remediation actions and timelines.</li> <li>Develop, document, and deliver technical remediation guidance and solutions to enable application and infrastructure teams to remediate efficiently and consistently.</li> <li>Support DOD IL4 and Fedramp preparation, by ensuring vulnerability management processes, evidence, reporting, and controls meet regulatory and assurance expectations.</li> <li>Work closely with engineering and service teams to embed vulnerability management into delivery pipelines , operational processes and change management. </li> <li>Leverage AI security tools and automation to streamline triage, pattern recognition, and risk prioritisation.</li> <li>Establish strong relationships with engineering teams to track and report status and remediation progress</li> <li>Manage and track the remediation backlog, maintaining focus on risk reduction and measurable progress.</li> <li>Contribute to the continuous improvement of vulnerability management standards, procedures, and playbooks, ensuring alignment with IL4, Fedramp and other compliance requirements.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Must-Have Skills</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Solid understanding of DoD Impact level IL4, FedRAMP, SOC-2, and PCI frameworks.</li> <li>3+ years  Vulnerability Management experience in a heavily regulated environment.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or security certifications in a related field.</li> <li>Strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with technical and non-technical teams.</li> <li>A strong understanding of CVSS (Common Vulnerability Scoring System) and how to apply risk assessment methodologies in a business context to support remediation..</li> <li>Hands-on experience with vulnerability scanning platforms (e.g., Qualys, Nessus, Rapid7 InsightVM).</li> <li>Strong analytical skills to identify patterns in data and distinguish between theoretical risk and actual exploitability.</li> <li>Practical experience using AI-powered security tools or generative AI assistants to accelerate vulnerability triage, code analysis, or remediation guidance.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></span></p> <ul> AI APIs into cybersecurity workflows and automation pipelines.</li> <li>Hands on experience with Infrastructure pentesting tools.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to title: Mid-Market Outcomes Architect
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn AI ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews - Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING - 5+ years of experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working - Native level Japanese, business level English NICE TO HAVES - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy. https://dev.notion.so/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21 #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Organisational Development Associate
location: Home Based - Americas; Home based - EMEA
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing.</p> <p>Canonical builds the open-source software that runs the world’s clouds, devices and AI, and we hold our managers to a high standard. Our Talent Development team exists to make leaders and managers at Canonical genuinely excellent. We define what great management looks like here, and we put that standard into the hands of managers and leaders across the company.</p> <p>The Organisational Development Associate is where our most driven early-career people begin. From day one you work with real teams and take on real change, coached hard by senior practitioners on a fast path toward running this work yourself. This is not a support or back-office role, and it is not generalist HR. We hire for potential, drive and coachability over a polished CV, and we back the people we hire to move fast. </p> <p>Applying to this role will enter you into our People Track for consideration across roles in the function.</p> <p><strong>Location</strong>: These are remote based positions, available across EMEA and the Americas.</p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Being embedded inside a real team: see how it works day to day, and surface what is and isn't working.</li> <li>Running the diagnostics on a team's health and management effectiveness (engagement, 360, direct feedback), and turning the evidence into a clear, honest read.</li> <li>Owning an improvement end to end: a concrete change to how a team works that you design, drive and land, with a senior practitioner alongside you.</li> <li>Supporting managers in delivering effective 360 performance feedback to individuals and helping them turn it into two or three real commitments they follow through on.</li> <li>Helping build the playbook: the standards, tools and shared language the whole function runs on. You are building the system others use, not producing filler.</li> <li>Learning coaching and organisational development directly from senior practitioners, on a fast, visible path to running this work yourself.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>A track record of leading and organising early. You have run things, built things, won people over and made change happen, in a startup, a student society, the military, a team, anywhere. People around you already see you as a driver.</li> <li>A deliberate pull toward developing people and organisations. You chose this field on purpose, with a real grounding in organisational or industrial psychology, behavioural science or a comparable basis. It is not a fallback.</li> <li>Drive and eagerness to learn. You have your own ideas and the confidence to challenge, and you are hungry to be coached and to grow fast.</li> <li>The presence to sit across from experienced people and talk about change with confidence. </li> <li>An exceptional academic track record from high school and university.</li> <li>Up to around two years of experience since graduating.</li> <li>Business level written and spoken English.</li> <li>Organised, accurate, confident, authentic, results-oriented, and enthusiastic.</li> <li>Sincere personal motivation aligned with our mission.</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events. </li> </ul> <p>In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being:</p> <ul> <li>Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity.</li> <li>Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence.</li> <li>Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable.</li> <li>Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Any exposure to people, organisational, coaching or consulting work, through study, an internship or a first job.</li> <li>A genuine interest in the craft of management and organisations, not just the subject matter.</li> <li>Comfort working with data.</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.</li> <li>Annual compensation review.</li> <li>Recognition rewards.</li> <li>Annual holiday leave.</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave.</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme.</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events.</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p>

title: General Manager, France
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: You will lead Notion’s GTM strategy and growth for France, one of EMEA’s largest and highest-priority markets. France is a Tier 1 region in Notion’s country-first EMEA model, with significant room to scale into a standalone, high-growth business. Notion is shifting from a traditional sales model toward a builder-led model with fewer handoffs, stronger technical fluency, and more direct ownership of customer outcomes. As General Manager, France, you will be the second-line leader responsible for overall revenue outcomes, regional GTM strategy, and the operating model for the French business. You will lead through frontline managers, teams of Business Development Representatives, Solutions Consultants and Outcomes Architects as well as partner cross functionally with Professional Services, Channel Partnerships and RevOps. This is a hands-on builder-leader role for an AI-native, country-first GTM model. You will bring Notion’s new GTM model to life in France: moving from a segment-first motion to a country-first, AI-native operating system where teams help customers diagnose problems, design agentic workflows, and build real systems with Notion AI. This role sits on the EMEA Leadership Team and reports to the General Manager, EMEA. This role will be based in Paris. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Own the GTM strategy, operating rhythm, and growth plan for France, with accountability for overall regional revenue outcomes across Sales Assist and Self Serve contribution. - Lead as a second-line manager: hire, coach, and develop frontline leaders and IC teams across Business Development, Solutions Consulting, Outcomes Architecture, Forward Deployed Architecture/Engineering, and supporting GTM functions. - Scale a country-first GTM motion that brings Notion closer to French customers through local executive engagement, market nuance, and faster field-level decision-making. - Accelerate the land engine by opening the right front doors, growing professional workspaces, increasing net-new and upgrade opportunities, and connecting self-serve signals to sales-assisted motion. - Win lighthouse customers and turn them into market momentum by making them wildly successful, telling their story locally, and using those wins to influence peer companies across France. - Embed Notion’s AI-era GTM model across the team, including agent-enabled customer journeys, first-agent workflow activation, AI/agent demo proficiency, and stronger “build with the customer” motions. - Make agentic transformation central to the French GTM motion: help customers identify high-value workflows, build and deploy Notion Agents, automate cross-functional work, and measure outcomes from AI adoption. - Partner tightly with Solutions Consultants, Outcomes Architects, Forward Deployed Architects/Engineers, Professional Services, Marketing and Channel to reduce handoffs and deliver faster, more durable customer value. - Build “sell with” partner motions in France, including partner-sourced pipeline, co-sell plays, enablement, AI/agentic solution packages, and joint account planning. - Establish Notion as a visible force in the French ecosystem through executive dinners, field events, startup and community engagement, partner activations, and customer advocacy. - Represent the voice of French customers back to Product, PMM, Marketing, and EMEA leadership, especially around AI transformation, enterprise requirements, security, compliance, localization, and competitive dynamics. - Create a talent destination in France by hiring builder-oriented leaders and ICs, raising the craft bar, and developing the next generation of AI-native GTM talent. - Drive operational excellence across forecasting, pipeline quality, territory planning, inspection cadence, performance management, and cross-functional execution. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR: A strategic and hands-on GTM operator who has scaled enterprise SaaS or AI businesses in France and knows how to build a market, not just inherit one. You have led through managers, owned complex revenue outcomes, and created local market momentum through customers, partners, community, and talent. You combine second-line leadership with builder energy. You can set a crisp country strategy, install the operating system to execute it, and step into the field when needed — whether joining an executive customer conversation, sharpening a pipeline plan, coaching a manager, or helping the team translate a customer problem into an AI-powered, agentic workflow. You are excited by Notion’s shift to an AI-native, country-first GTM model and believe the best GTM teams will increasingly be builders: BDRs who identify transformation opportunities, Solutions Consultants who build with customers in the room, Outcomes Architects who turn early workflows into durable adoption, and Forward Deployed Architects/Engineers who design the technical systems behind complex agentic workflows. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - 12+ years of professional experience, including 5+ years leading SaaS or AI sales & GTM teams in France. - Deep knowledge of the French enterprise and startup ecosystem, including executive buyer networks, local partner channels, and market-specific buying dynamics across all market segments (commercial, midmarket and enterprise) - Proven second-line leadership experience, including hiring, coaching, and developing frontline managers and high-performing IC teams. - Track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets across new business, expansion, and renewal/churn dynamics. - Agency & Urgency: experience building or scaling a regional/country business in a high-growth or ambiguous environment. - Experience selling, implementing, or leading GTM teams around AI, automation, agentic workflows, collaboration, productivity, developer, or data products. - Strong strategic judgment: ability to define a country plan, segment the market, prioritize accounts and plays, and align cross-functional teams around outcomes. - Operational rigor across forecasting, pipeline generation, inspection, performance management, territory planning, and sales process. - Executive presence with CIO, CTO, CPO, COO, and business transformation buyers, with the ability to shape a compelling AI and agentic workflow narrative. - Strong understanding of modern GTM motions across Business Development, Solutions Consulting, Outcomes Architecture, Forward Deployed Architecture/Engineering, Professional Services, Channel, Marketing, RevOps, and Product. - Builder mentality and deep AI curiosity: comfortable learning, demoing, and coaching teams on agent-first workflows, proof-of-value motions, and customer co-building. - Fluency in French and English. NICE TO HAVES: - Experience launching or scaling a country-first or regional GTM operating model. - Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, APIs, webhooks, connectors, data residency, AI governance, and technical evaluation processes. - Experience scaling partner, channel, marketplace, or consultant-led GTM motions around AI or workflow transformation. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €350,000 - €408,000 per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21 #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Manager, People Analytics
location: Home Based - Americas; Home based - EMEA
description: <p>The Workplace Engineering function sits at the intersection of traditional HR analytics and modern Product Engineering. We transform raw workforce data into a suite of "People Products" that drive high performance. We don’t just "report" on what happened; we engineer the tools and insights that determine what happens next.</p> <p>This new role will report directly to the Global Head of Workplace Engineering, and sits within our Data discipline inside of our People department. Experienced data professionals at Canonical live at the intersection of software, data, and the business. They don't just help surface analytic artifacts; they help transform them into a strategic asset that elevates decision making and innovation across our global operations (e.g., sales, marketing, engineering, and human resources). They balance technical precision with business pragmatism, designing and iterating on experiments, automations, and products that transform insights into valued outcomes. They shape tomorrow's AI/Data stack in open source, ensuring that Canonical remains at the forefront of data-driven excellence. Their curiosity is contagious and has an amplifying effect on data literacy and stewardship across the business teams they support.</p> <p>Location: This is a remote role based in the AMER or EMEA Region.</p> <h3>The role entails</h3> <ul> <li>Multi-Disciplinary Leadership:  Lead and mentor a specialized squad of People Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and UX Designers. You aren't just managing analysts; you are leading a product squad.</li> <li>Product Ownership on People Science: Bridge the gap between "HR-speak" and "Dev-speak", ensuring engineers understand the human behavioral intent behind the code.</li> <li>Strategic Insight & Business Outcomes: Move beyond descriptive metrics (e.g., turnover rate) to predictive and prescriptive insights (e.g., predicting attrition risk based on "Time-Product" engagement data).</li> <li>Data Stewardship & Product Storytelling: Act as the "Translator-in-Chief". Take complex data models and turn them into compelling narratives. Lead the development of AI Agents that can surface insights to managers in real-time. Ensure the "People Data Stack" is secure, GDPR/privacy-compliant, and acts as a "Single Source of Truth" across all People related offerings, products and services.</li> <li>“Effectiveness at Work” Strategy: Identify opportunities to leverage “High Tech” solutions in our People offerings, and free up more time for “High Touch”, human involvement, thereby maximizing human value.</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>Background in data science, mathematics, or engineering, skilled in advanced statistics, data wrangling/science, databases (SQL, etc.) or software engineering.</li> <li>Strength in coding/scripting languages (Python, R, JavaScript, etc.), software engineering, visualization (e.g. Superset, Tableau), and automation.</li> <li>Ability to translate business questions to key research objectives.</li> <li>Ability to identify the best methodology to execute research, synthesize and analyze findings.</li> <li>Proven ability to lead and drive others to execute against well planned roadmaps, with a strong mentor/coaching mindset. </li> <li>Willingness to examine the status quo and be resilient in the face of challenges.</li> <li>Ambition to build tomorrow's AI/Data stack in open source.</li> <li>An exceptional academic track record from high school and university.</li> <li>Business level written and spoken English.</li> <li>Sincere personal motivation aligned with our mission.</li> <li>International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <p>In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being:</p> <ul> <li>Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity.</li> <li>Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence.</li> <li>Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable.</li> <li>Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.</li> </ul> <h3>Nice-to-have skills</h3> <ul> <li>Experience with dbt (Data Build Tool), Airbyte, Ranger, Superset, Temporal, or Trino</li> <li>Basic understanding of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes</li> <li>Agentic Engineering</li> <li>Product management</li> <li>User experience and design</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We assess performance and revisit compensation twice annually to ensure we recognize outstanding colleagues. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review</li> <li>Company recognition rewards</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

track record in open source</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You have a working knowledge of Go</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span title: Engineering Director, Devices Software Engineering
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. <strong>Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives</strong> such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 80+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing.</p> <p>We are hiring an <strong>Engineer Director, Devices Software Engineering</strong> to drive the strategy and implementation of our next-generation Ubuntu hardware enablement quality. This critical function is part of our mission to transform Linux certification, in partnership with the engineering directors of Ubuntu Enablement and Ubuntu Certification. Our goal is to deliver the world's best long term OS stability commitment on PC, server and IoT hardware.</p> <p>We believe that Engineering Directors should be outstanding engineers themselves. They should be very comfortable reviewing a patch or a software design spec. They are trusted engineers who understand the importance of a whole-team effort in creating great products, and who enjoy seeing colleagues develop. They should contribute code themselves to set the standard for coding, but know that the code they write is far less significant than their ability to shape the whole team’s direction, focus and delivery. We grow management skills, and train engineers who are interested in soft skills to be managers. Even though this is a director level position, managing managers, we expect Engineering Directors to be outstanding system software engineers with the confidence to lead by example across the full range of activities in their teams. You’ll need to know how to drive testing and benchmarking to improve the clarity in your teams around quality and performance. You’ll also need to be confident to set and defend high expectations of work ethic, consistency, focus and learning.</p> <p>In this Engineering Director role, you will lead the strategy and the team responsible for quality coordination and integration testing of our software stacks with hardware. We are looking for a quality expert with the ability to establish quality processes from the ground up. The candidate must understand today's PC and ARM IoT hardware, and be excited about the new generation of RISC-V hardware that is on the horizon. They should understand the board and device product lifecycle and know the tools and techniques used to introduce new products. They will work with teams across the company to drive quality improvements through the entire development cycle. This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill combined with management experience.</p> <p>Today, most Linux certification is poor quality. Vendors run one set of tests and then declare that 'the hardware is certified'. But Linux is not a static platform. We make many more security fixes in the Linux world than people traditionally made in the proprietary OS world - all of these need to be tested on hardware which has been certified, even if that certification is 'old'. Also, Linux and open source evolve significantly every six months, and even more between major enterprise releases like the Ubuntu LTS versions. During the lifespan of an LTS, new kernel improvements will be available to users, and they want to be sure that their hardware will work. Today's Linux certification programs do not meet the needs of its users, and we want to change that.</p> <p>Our intention is to deliver <strong>continuous quality and certification</strong> across the entire portfolio of certified hardware. Once we have enabled and certified a device, we intend to keep testing it to ensure that every single change we deliver to Ubuntu users globally is verified on all the hardware we know about. We also intend to <strong>measure energy consumption</strong> on a continuous process, as part of our commitment to <strong>measure, manage and drive down the carbon footprint of Ubuntu</strong> usage around the planet. We are building the world's largest and best-equipped Linux device certification facility in Taipei, which will enable this continuous testing. We are also structuring our renewed partnership and customer agreements to facilitate this process going forward.</p> <p>We believe that open source is just starting to transform the tech sector and enterprise compute. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of ‘most software to most companies’. To deliver on that ambition, our engineers are carefully selected from the applicants across the globe. We select for brilliance and motivation to take open source to the next level. Our engineering directors and managers help teams achieve more than they thought they could, and feel proud of the result.</p> <p>As an Engineering Director at Canonical your primary responsibility is to the teams you lead, to ensure that they measure outcomes, make process improvements, do valuable work, and find career satisfaction at Canonical. Technical leadership is a requirement, so that you’re able to challenge and grow your teams. Strong aptitude for planning, management and operations are necessary too. You will have the opportunity to influence our culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your teams on strategy and execution. You’ll select, develop, retain and lead teams of excellent software developers to design and implement software that runs on various CPU architectures, such as ARM, RISC-V, and x86. You will meet with stakeholders, prioritize requests, plan your roadmap and ensure the team can deliver their goals.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> As an Engineering Director position, this requires a candidate who is confident to run a project which spans several teams and time zones, hiring and managing both engineering managers and staff engineers. The role is part of our global Canonical and Ubuntu engineering organisation. We prefer to appoint a candidate who will base themselves in our Taipei Minsheng office, alongside other enablement engineering leaders, and close to the stream of new hardware that goes into the certification lab.</p> <h3>Key responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Manage, mentor and grow the software engineering teams addressing hardware enablement quality assurance and testing</li> <li>Lead the OEM QA Engineering team activity, which covers</li> <ul> <li>Planning, creation and management of the overall quality planning strategy and documents</li> <li>Improving our automated test capability with design and code contributions</li> <li>Execution of automated and manual testing of Ubuntu Desktop and Core</li> <li>Test result triage and precise bug creation</li> <li>Suggesting solutions to identified problems</li> <li>Overseeing continuous improvement projects </li> <li>Establishing proactive measures to improve the quality and reliability of Ubuntu</li> <li>Preparing time estimates and schedule for testing activities</li> <li>Work with development teams across multiple projects to build efficient, effective automated testing</li> </ul> <li>Develop your engineering managers and maintain Canonical culture</li> <li>Hire staff level engineers for specific roles like performance and quality</li> <li>Identify and measure indicators of team health and productivity</li> <li>Implement rigorous engineering processes and defend them</li> <li>Set and measure progress against benchmark goals for speed and efficiency</li> <li>Represent your product to stakeholders, title: Product Manager

During the interview process we will identify specific software products which would be a good fit for your interests.</p> <p>We believe that open source is transforming the way that enterprises solve their business needs. Although open source has been around for thirty years, it is only now fundamental to every corner of the software landscape. Going forward we believe open source will have an even bigger impact as it moves into specialised vertical markets. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of ‘most software to most companies’, starting with Ubuntu but expanding to cover every class of application on every class of compute. To deliver on that ambition, we select product managers for their intellect and strong drive to advance the open source community. Together, we aim to improve open source quality, outreach, and impact. Our product managers set the vision and the direction to ensure teams deliver the right products in the right markets at the right time. They push the boundaries of the technology landscape to identify and deliver products into new and existing market opportunities.</p> <p>Our product managers are technology professionals with a software engineering background who strive to become business executives and entrepreneurs. You will be expected to be located in this region.</p> <h3>The role entails</h3> <ul> <li>Lead the product development lifecycle, reviewing the priorities and goals for your product</li> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as engineering, design, marketing, and sales</li> <li>Address common challenges across projects, align on priorities, enable informed decisions, and keep business execution on track</li> <li>Conduct market research, analyse industry trends, and gather customer feedback to identify opportunities</li> <li>Communicate your product vision, status updates, and key decisions to ensure alignment and manage expectations</li> <li>Conduct usability testing, analyse user feedback, and iterate on the product to improve the user experience</li> <li>Collaborate with marketing, sales, and support teams to develop go-to-market strategies, create product documentation, and provide training</li> <li>Contribute to the success of our sales team in winning new opportunities, reviewing customer feedback and participating in customer meetings</li> <li>Oversee the work of a product line, ensuring consistency in strategy and execution across different teams</li> <li>Facilitate collaboration and resolve conflicts within different teams and across other departments</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic results at high school and university</li> <li>Understanding of Linux and the wider open source software community</li> <li>Understanding of computer architecture, application development, datacenters, cloud or devices</li> <li>Passion to write about technologies and the tech landscape</li> <li>A strong work ethic, and personal interests aligned with the open source movement</li> <li>Curiosity, and the habit of continuous learning</li> <li>A strong sense of ownership</li> <li>Problem solving and the ability to innovate</li> <li>Outstanding communications skills in English, both verbal and written</li> <li>For more senior positions, product management experience in the software industry</li> <li>Ability to manage multiple projects or product lines while maintaining focus on key priorities</li> <li>Demonstrated leadership in aligning diverse teams and driving consensus around product strategies</li> <li>Willingness to travel internationally up to 4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <h3>Additional skills that we value</h3> <ul> <li>Familiarity with a particular verticals (e.g. Telco, Finance, Industrial, Automotive)</li> containers & Snaps</li> <li>Familiarity with embedded and connected device technology and ecosystems</li> <li>Familiarity with networking technologies - ethernet, IPv4 and IPv6, routing, firewalling, overlays such as OVN/OVS, VPNs, SR-IOV, infiniband</li> <li>Familiarity with telco networking - RAN, Core, CPE</li> <li>Experience in leading distributed teams across different time zones</li> title: Python Software Engineer - Ubuntu Hardware Certification Team
description: <p>Canonical is hiring a Python Software Engineer to join the Certification team, who make the tools which enable us to know that a desktop, laptop, server or IoT device is working properly. Canonical offers a fun, fast-paced team environment and a career full of learning and development opportunities. This team is centered in EMEA time zones, and works with colleagues on related teams in both the Americas and APAC.</p> <p>We work together with silicon companies, OEMs, ODMs and teams within Canonical to ensure a smooth, secure out of the box Ubuntu experience, with success in this role leading to a great Ubuntu experience being offered on more and more devices.</p> <h3>Role description</h3> <p>We are looking for a self-motivated software engineer with experience developing in Python, to work on test automation tools or Linux based embedded hardware. This role offers an exciting opportunity to push the industry forward by enabling entirely new Linux based hardware testing capabilities, scaling up hardware certification efforts and allowing for deeper test coverage.</p> <p>The role involves the development and maintenance of Canonical’s open source certification tools, supporting the creation of hardware solutions for test automation, and automating our existing processes. We seek out continuous process and tooling improvements as part of expanding the certification test suites, ultimately to improve the quality of Linux experience felt by millions of Linux end users.</p> <h3>Key responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Maintain and develop new features to our Python based test automation tools like  <a href="https://checkbox.readthedocs.io">Checkbox</a>, used by both in-house teams and industry partners.</li> <li>Invent new ways to enable remote, automated testing.</li> <li>Help build the software counterpart to in-house designed testing hardware to help test device enablement (graphics, hotplug, bluetooth, etc).</li> <li>Write functional and performance tests to support hardware enablement and to protect from regressions.</li> <li>Participate in meetings involving international travel 2-3 times per year.</li> </ul> <h3>Required skills and experience</h3> <ul> <li>Knowledge of Python programming language.</li> <li>Quality oriented, pragmatic approach to software design and implementation.</li> <li>Interest in test automation methodologies.</li> <li>Previous experience working with Ubuntu or other Linux distributions.</li> <li>Ability to be productive in a globally distributed team.</li> </ul> <h3>Desired skills and experience</h3> <ul> <li>Passion for tinkering: you are a maker.</li> <li>Experience working in an agile environment.</li> <li>Hardware testing experience, for example in the IoT space.</li> <li>Familiarity with the C programming language.</li> </ul> <h3>What is Canonical?</h3> <p>Canonical is a growing international software company that works with the open-source community to deliver Ubuntu, “the world’s best free software platform”. title: Renewals Sales Manager, Americas
description: <p>Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.</p> <p>We are profitable and growing our global enterprise sales organisation. We are hiring a <strong>regional sales renewal team manager</strong> in North America to lead the renewals team in the region.</p> <p>We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.</p> <p>Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.</p> <p>Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and over $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.</p> <p>We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.</p> <p>In building our sales team, we look for five things:</p> <ul> <li>Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems</li> <li>High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence</li> <li>Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes</li> <li>Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions</li> <li>Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers</li> </ul> <p>Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.</p> <p>The successful candidate will carry an annual team bookings quota within their territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagements or, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness in managing their team. They will need to coach, mentor and lead by example. Their sales representatives are expected to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open sales team manager roles in every region.</p> <h3>What your day will look like</h3> <ul> <li>Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting</li> <li>Allocate portions of territory and accounts to sales representatives on your team</li> <li>Identify and prioritise new logo accounts in your territory for account-based marketing and prospecting</li> <li>Ensure that sales representatives have high quality account plans for existing accounts and priority prospects</li> bookings targets</li> <li>Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives</li> <li>Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities</li> <li>Ensure your team maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce</li> <li>Represent the company, its solutions and software</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science</li> <li>Leadership and management skill</li> <li>Experience of open source technology and solutions</li> <li>Detail oriented with effective title: Sales Enablement Manager
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>We are hiring a <strong>Sales Enablement</strong> leader to architect the growth journey for our global sales organization. At Canonical, sales enablement isn't just about onboarding; it’s about ensuring our teams can articulate the complex value of Ubuntu, OpenStack, and AI infrastructure to the world’s most sophisticated tech leaders. You will act as a trusted partner to identify, scope, and implement tooling and workflow improvements that drive efficiency and reduce friction in the sales process. You will sit at the intersection of Product, Marketing, and Sales, transforming high-level strategy into actionable field excellence.</p> <p>If you are an experienced <strong>leader </strong>ready to lead global strategy, you will find a high-performance environment that challenges you. You will work with Sales Leadership to identify performance gaps, reduce ramp time, improve productivity and increase win rates. This is a high-visibility role where you will ensure our "distributed-first" workforce remains the sharpest in the industry.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> These are EMEA-based remote roles.</p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead enablement programs to drive continuous improvement in sales productivity and ramp time</li> <li>Lead the design and execution of global sales enablement strategies to drive revenue growth </li> <li>Provide coaching and mentoring that incorporates sales strategy, process and proven sales methodology</li> <li>Drive the creation of advanced sales plays and competitive intelligence resources for enterprise markets</li> <li>Collaborate and align cross-functionally with Sales, Revenue Operations, Product, Marketing, and all GTM teams to ensure enablement strategy supports broader organizational objectives</li> <li>Own the end-to-end sales onboarding experience, ensuring new hires reach peak productivity rapidly</li> <li>Identify and deliver training needs for Sales teams for continuous improvements</li> <li>Collaborate with Product Management and Marketing to translate technical roadmaps into value-based sales narratives</li> <li>Manage the sales enablement tech stack (CRM, LMS, etc.) to ensure tools are optimizing, not hindering, the sales process through right-time right-place delivery</li> <li>Provide a framework to relevant teams to develop and maintain high-quality sales assets, including discovery guides, pitch decks, and battlecards</li> <li>Facilitate live and virtual training sessions on advanced product features and sales techniques</li> <li>Coordinate the logistics for global sales training events and twice-yearly "sprint" weeks</li> <li>Monitor, report and act on the adoption and effectiveness of enablement initiatives using data-driven insights</li> <li>Support the senior team in preparing reports for leadership and auditing sales documentation for accuracy</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>Demonstrated experience coaching sales leaders and diagnosing business challenges to drive organizational improvement</li> <li>Proficiency in a modern sales methodology such as MEDDPICC – able to coach leaders and sellers using this methodology</li> <li>Ability to align and influence others, establish direction, achieve consensus, and execute</li> <li>Experience building enablement programs from the ground up in emerging or high-growth markets</li> <li>Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results</li> <li>Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship</li> <li>Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability</li> <li>Appreciative of diversity and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization</li> <li>Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments</li> <li>Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience in sales enablement, technical training, or sales operations (level-dependent)</li> <li>Proficiency with Salesforce, modern LMS platforms and project management tools (e.g. Jira)</li> <li>Basic knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP)</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
